2602.12125.summary: 提出 G-OPD 框架，理论证明 OPD 是 dense KL-RL 的特例，引入奖励缩放因子 λ 和灵活 reference model。λ>1（ExOPD）在同等规模蒸馏和强到弱蒸馏中均稳定超越标准 OPD，多师蒸馏时学生甚至突破所有领域教师的性能上界。

method.training_loop: student 自采样轨迹 y~π_θ → 对每个 token 计算 token-level advantage A_t = (log π_θ - log π*) + (λ-1)(log π_ref - log π*) → policy gradient 更新 θ；π_ref 默认为 student 初始策略，强到弱场景可换为教师预 RL 基座（reward correction）；使用 token-level rollout correction 消除训练推理不一致
method.loss_formulation: J_{G\text{-}OPD}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{x\sim\mathcal{D},\, y\sim\pi_\theta(\cdot|x)}\!\left[\lambda\log\frac{\pi^*(y|x)}{\pi_{\text{ref}}(y|x)} - D_{\text{KL}}(\pi_\theta(y|x)\|\pi_{\text{ref}}(y|x))\right]
method.data_source: Math RL：DeepMath 过滤难度≥6 共 57K 样本；Code RL：Eurus-RL-Code 共 25K 样本；蒸馏数据与 RL 数据相同
key_components: reward scaling factor λ（插值/外推控制）
flexible reference model π_ref
token-level dense reward（log π*/π_ref）
token-level rollout correction
reward correction（strong-to-weak：π_ref=teacher's pre-RL base）

2602.12125.novelty: 标准 OPD 固定 λ=1、π_ref=student 初始策略，G-OPD 解除两者约束：λ>1（ExOPD）允许学生超越教师能力边界，而非仅模仿；π_ref 换为教师预 RL 基座可获取更准确的隐式奖励信号。理论上首次形式化证明 OPD 等价于 dense KL-RL（β=1），为奖励缩放提供理论依据；实践上 ExOPD 是首个在多师蒸馏中稳定超越所有领域教师的方法。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: The main idea of OPD is to let the student generate its own trajectories, and then minimize the reverse KL divergence between the student and the teacher π∗ on those student-generated trajectories. Notice that in Eq.(4), the trajectories y are generated by the policy model itself, resulting in the on-policy training. G-OPD(θ) = max_{θ} E_{x∼D, y∼π_θ(·|x)} [ λ log π*(y|x)/π_ref(y|x) − D_KL(π_θ(y|x) || π_ref(y|x)) ]

opd_classification.reasoning: 学生在训练循环内实时采样轨迹，教师提供 token-level log-prob 监督（logits），属于 external-teacher on-policy distillation（§5.2）；ExOPD λ>1 是对标准 OPD 的奖励外推扩展，reward correction 变体引入 verifier（binary reward）辅助构造更准确 reference，涉及 §5.3.3 边界。

key_findings: ExOPD（λ=1.25）在同等规模单师蒸馏中 math avg 48.0 超过教师 46.0，且优于 OPD（46.5）和继续对教师做 RL（46.9），以更少步数（50步 vs 100步）实现更高性能
多师蒸馏中 ExOPD 是唯一能稳定超越所有领域教师（math avg +1.7、code avg +0.8 于各自教师）的方法，SFT/OPD/ExPO 均无法做到
强到弱蒸馏（30B→1.7B）ExOPD vs OPD：math avg +2.3（25.4 vs 23.1），加 reward correction 再 +0.6；30B→4B：math avg +2.7（45.3 vs 42.6）
2602.12125.ablations_summary: λ 超参消融（{0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0,1.25,1.5}）：λ=1.25 最优，λ=1.5 因隐式奖励 hacking 导致性能下降；reward correction（π_ref 换为教师预 RL 基座）在强到弱场景一致提升 ExOPD +0.6(math) / +1.0(code)；更强教师（1200步 RL）下 ExOPD 仍优于 OPD，验证方法鲁棒性
limitations: λ>1 需额外计算 reference model log-prob，增加计算开销
Reward correction 需访问教师的预 RL 基座模型，额外计算开销
λ=1.5 过度外推导致隐式奖励 hacking，性能不稳定
隐式奖励存在 length bias，ExOPD 倾向生成更长回复
强到弱场景中 student/teacher 能力差距导致 log(π*/π_student_base) 含噪
过多蒸馏步数可能导致过拟合
尚未在更大规模模型、更多样化领域教师、不同模型家族上验证
failure_modes: λ=1.5 时出现隐式奖励 hacking：student 激进拟合 log ratio 峰值 token，即使这些 token 的 log ratio 存在偏差，导致性能下降
强到弱场景中 student 与 teacher 分布偏差使默认 reward signal 含噪，奖励信号不准确

theory.theoretical_claim: OPD is KL-RL equivalence with β=1; optimal G-OPD policy: log π_θ = λ·log π* + (1-λ)·log π_ref
theory.proof_sketch: 通过 score function identity E[∇_θ log π_θ]=0 消去 OPD 梯度中 t'<t 的交叉项，证明 OPD 梯度等价于 dense KL-RL（β=1）的策略梯度；最优解 log π_θ* = λ log π* + (1-λ) log π_ref 由变分法直接得出，展示 λ 控制插值/外推行为

2602.12125.relevance_to_opd: 本文即 OPD 的核心理论与方法研究：证明 OPD 等价于 dense KL-RL，提出 G-OPD/ExOPD 框架，是 OPD 的直接理论延伸和实践改进，高度相关

2602.04942.title: Privileged Information Distillation for Language Models
2602.04942.summary: 提出 π-Distill 和 OPSD 两种算法，通过特权信息（PI）将前沿模型能力蒸馏到小模型。π-Distill 以共享参数同时训练 PI 条件化 teacher 和无 PI student；OPSD 为 on-policy 自蒸馏。仅用 action-level PI，在多个 agentic benchmark 上超越 SFT w/ CoT + RL 行业标准。

method.training_loop: π-Distill: 共享参数 θ 同时优化 teacher J_Teacher(θ)（teacher 采样轨迹，student 用 importance-weighted RL 从 teacher 轨迹学习）和 student J_Student(θ)，总目标 J=α·J_T+(1-α)·J_S，α 从0线性增至0.5。OPSD: student 自身采样轨迹，PI-conditioned teacher 提供 KL 正则信号；均基于 GRPO，400 gradient steps，2×H100。
method.loss_formulation: J_{\pi\text{-Distill}}(\theta) = \alpha J_{\text{Teacher}}(\theta) + (1-\alpha)J_{\text{Student}}(\theta), \quad J_{\text{OPSD}}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{o\sim\pi_\theta^S, s\sim P}\left[R(o,s) - \beta D_{\mathrm{KL}}\left(\pi_\theta^S(o|s)\,\|\,\mathrm{sg}(\pi_\theta^T(o|s,I))\right)\right]
method.data_source: DeepSeek-chat-v3.1 成功轨迹：τ-Bench retail 15885条、Travel Planner 1986条；特权信息形式：工具调用+参数 / 工具调用名 / 自生成 hint
key_components: 共享参数 θ 的 teacher/student 双头架构
反向 KL 正则（β 系数）
α 参数线性退火（0→0.5，15 epochs）
GRPO 策略优化（ε 裁剪 0.8/1.2）
stop-gradient 算子稳定训练
超长轨迹长度惩罚（>15k tokens）

2602.04942.novelty: 与 STaR/Zhou et al.(2025) 等先验工作相比：(1) 单模型共享参数同时训练 teacher 和 student，无需独立模型或两阶段流程；(2) 仅需 action-level PI，不需要 CoT 推理链；(3) 从 variational EM 角度给出统一理论推导；(4) 首次在无 GT answer 的长程 agentic 任务上验证 on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: OPSD performs on-policy learning where the student acts as the sampling policy. Training-time privileged information (PI) can enable language models to succeed on tasks they would otherwise fail, making it a powerful tool for Reinforcement Learning (RL) in hard, long-horizon settings. However, transferring capabilities learned with PI to policies that must act without it at inference time remains a fundamental challenge.

opd_classification.reasoning: OPSD 是 student on-policy 采样 + PI-conditioned teacher 提供 KL 监督信号，PI 来自前沿模型成功轨迹（demos），属于 PI(demos) → §5.3.1；π-Distill 的 student 从 teacher 离线轨迹学习，偏 §5.2 off-policy KD。

stabilization_tricks: no KL penalty with base model reference

eval: GEM QA (2Wiki, PopQA, TriviaQA, HotpotQA, Bamboogle, NaturalQuestions, Musique)

key_findings: π-Distill (α=1) 在 Travel Planner 上达到 44.1%，比行业标准 SFT w/ CoT + RL（32.3%）高 11.8 个百分点（Qwen3-8B）
π-Distill (α=0) 在 τ-Bench Retail 上达到 31.1%，超越 SFT w/ CoT + RL（29.1%）2 个百分点，且仅需单阶段训练
R1-Distill-Llama-8B 在无 SFT 热启动时完全失败（0%），加入 SFT w/ CoT 热启动后 π-Distill 才恢复到 14.1%，揭示模型初始化对 PI 利用的关键作用
2602.04942.ablations_summary: α 消融：α=0.5 最鲁棒（16场景中7次最优，1次最差）；α=0 在 KL 大或 utility 为负时失败；α=1 在 KL 小时退化为 teacher≈student 策略崩溃。β 消融：β>0 对 α>0 时的稳定至关重要（21配置中17次有效）。PI 类型消融：信息量越丰富（工具调用+参数 > 工具名 > hint）效果越好，但 OPSD 对 KL 大小更敏感。
limitations: 所有 PI 均来自前沿模型轨迹，无法处理既无前沿模型也无 GT answer 的场景
实验仅覆盖 ≤8B 参数量模型，更大规模扩展未验证
第7节分析为观察性研究，未系统控制变量
failure_modes: R1-Distill-Llama-8B 无热启动时完全崩溃（τ-Bench Retail 和 Travel Planner 均为 0%）
Travel Planner 原始 rubric 奖励导致策略崩溃（reward hacking），需解耦易/难约束奖励
α=1 且 KL 接近零时 teacher 退化为 student，PI 被忽略
OPSD 在 Qwen3-4B OOD 任务上显著退化，疑似过拟合 teacher 监督

theory.theoretical_claim: π-Distill 从 variational EM 推导：E-step 优化 PI-conditioned teacher 逼近 reward-tilted posterior π*(o|s)∝π_ref·exp(R)，M-step 将知识蒸馏到 student，共享参数实现单阶段同步优化
theory.proof_sketch: 目标后验 π*(o|s) = π_ref(o|s)exp(R(o,s))/Z；teacher 最小化反向 KL D_KL(π_T || π*)；student 通过 importance-weighted RL 从 teacher 轨迹学习；无形式收敛证明，仅推导与直觉分析

2602.04942.relevance_to_opd: 核心即 OPD 场景：OPSD 是 student on-policy 采样 + PI-conditioned self-teacher 提供 KL 信号，完全匹配 §5.3.1（student rollout + PI(demos) signal）；π-Distill 是 off-policy KD 变体（§5.2），teacher 用 PI 条件化前沿模型轨迹监督 student。两者均研究如何在训练时利用特权信息、推理时不依赖 PI。

2602.02994.title: Video-OPD: Efficient Post-Training of Multimodal Large Language Models for Temporal Video Grounding via On-Policy Distillation
2602.02994.summary: 针对时序视频定位（TVG）任务，Video-OPD 将 on-policy 蒸馏引入多模态 LLM 后训练：学生在线采样轨迹，固定教师模型仅对学生 token 打分（逆向 KL 逐 token 奖励），以密集信号替代 GRPO 的稀疏序列奖励，仅需单次 rollout，配合 TVDF 课程数据选择，在三个 TVG 基准上平均超 GRPO ~17%，计算成本降至约 20%。

method.training_loop: ①从当前学生策略 π_θ 对 (v,q) 采一条轨迹 τ=(a_1…a_T)，记录 log π_θ(a_t|s_t)；②固定教师 π_tea 计算同一序列每个 token 的条件对数概率；③计算逐 token 奖励 r_t=-(log π_θ(a_t|s_t)-log π_tea(a_t|s_t))；④用重要性加权策略梯度更新 θ；全程单 rollout，无分组归一化
method.loss_formulation: \mathcal{L} = -\mathbb{E}_{\tau\sim\pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}}}\left[\sum_{t=1}^{T} r_t \frac{\pi_\theta(a_t|s_t)}{\pi_{\theta_{\text{old}}}(a_t|s_t)} \nabla_\theta \log\pi_\theta(a_t|s_t)\right], \quad r_t = -(\log\pi_\theta(a_t|s_t) - \log\pi_{\text{tea}}(a_t|s_t))
method.data_source: HiREST、QuerYD、HowTo-Interlink7M、VTimeLLM、DiDeMo 及 TimeLens-100K 时序标注，共 96,586 条 TVG 实例；经 TVDF 课程筛选后每轮使用 2,500 条
key_components: On-Policy Distillation with reverse-KL token-level rewards
Teacher-Validated Disagreement Focusing (TVDF)
Teacher Reliability Pre-Validation (TRPV)
Disagreement-Based Trajectory Prioritization (DBTP / Top-k DBS)
No-thinking mode for Qwen3-VL
Multi-round iterative training

2602.02994.novelty: GRPO 对 TVG 有两大缺陷：①序列级稀疏奖励导致信用分配差；②多 rollout（G=8）训练成本高。Video-OPD 用逐 token 逆向 KL 奖励替代稀疏 IoU 奖励，实现密集信号；仅需单 rollout，消除分组归一化；首次将 on-policy distillation 引入 TVG 多模态 LLM 后训练，并配套 TVDF 课程选择教师可信且师生分歧最大的样本优先训练。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: In each training iteration, Video-OPD first samples a trajectory τ = (a1, . . . , aT ) ∼ πθ(·|v, q) from the current student policy, recording the token-level log-probabilities log πθ(at|st). Then the fixed high-capacity teacher model πtea computes conditional log-probabilities over each token in the student-generated trajectory. The teacher never generates its own tokens—it only scores the student's on-policy samples. The per-token reward is defined as rt = −(log πθ(at|st) − log πtea(at|st)).

opd_classification.reasoning: 学生每步在线采样轨迹，由外部固定教师模型提供 token 级 logits 信号，属于 external-teacher on-policy distillation（§5.2）；TVDF 数据选择为辅助机制

teacher_student_pairs._note: Intentional: 4B-GRPO teacher → 8B student explores smaller RL-trained model as teacher (ablation from paper Table showing this still works but 32B teacher is better)

key_findings: Video-OPD 在三个 TVG 基准上平均超越 GRPO 约 17%（基线仅 ~12%），而训练时仅使用单次 rollout，计算成本约为 GRPO 的 20%
经过 3 轮迭代，8B 学生在全部 TVG 基准超越 32B-GRPO 教师（如 QVHighlights mIoU：64.6 vs. 教师 58.4），且仅用 7,500 条样本，优于依赖 12,000 条样本的 TimeLens-8B
Thinking 模式对 TVG 有害：开启后 Charades mIoU 从 52.0 降至 48.7，禁用思维链反而更优
2602.02994.ablations_summary: TVDF 两组件（TRPV + DBTP）各自贡献约 0.5-1.5% mIoU，合并约 +2%；教师越强学生上限越高，但 32B 教师一轮后师生差距收敛到 0.1 mIoU；Top-k DBS 采样策略优于 GWDS/BBDS/DSUS；off-policy 蒸馏（OP-RKD/OP-FKD）在 TVG 落后 Video-OPD 且损害通用视频理解能力
limitations: 需要访问能计算学生 token 条件对数概率的高容量教师模型，对教师可用性和可靠性有依赖
单轮训练时当教师（32B）与学生（8B）容量差异大，不能完全收敛，需多轮迭代
TVDF 中 TRPV 依赖教师在时序边界预测上的一致性来过滤样本，长视频中教师可靠性仍是隐患
failure_modes: 开启 Thinking 模式（chain-of-thought）后 TVG 性能显著下降（Charades mIoU 52.0→48.7，ActivityNet 47.3→37.0，QVHighlights 61.0→44.1）
Off-policy 蒸馏（OP-RKD/OP-FKD）导致通用视频理解（TempCompass、MVBench、Video-MME）性能退化

theory.theoretical_claim: Video-OPD 期望更新等价于最小化逐状态逆向 KL：E[r_t ∇log π_θ]=∇D_KL(π_θ||π_tea)；密集奖励降低策略梯度方差，收敛速度理论上优于 GRPO
theory.proof_sketch: 附录 A：(1)逐 token 奖励密度严格高于 GRPO 的 O(1) 序列奖励；(2)方差分解证明逐 token 奖励消除 GRPO 中跨时间步强正相关引起的方差膨胀；(3)期望策略梯度恒等式证明 Video-OPD 等价于对逆向 KL 做在线随机梯度下降

2602.02994.relevance_to_opd: 本文即 OPD 核心案例：提出 Video-OPD 框架，将 on-policy distillation 应用于多模态 LLM TVG 后训练，学生在线采样轨迹 + 外部固定教师提供 token 级 logits 信号，是 §5.2 外部教师 on-policy 蒸馏的直接实例，并通过 TVDF 课程选择进一步强化信号质量

2602.02405.title: Didactic to Constructive: Turning Expert Solutions into Learnable Reasoning
2602.02405.summary: DAIL（Distribution Aligned Imitation Learning）将专家人类解答通过特权学生（student model conditioned on expert solution）转化为符合学生分布的推理轨迹，再用对比目标惩罚捷径学习。仅用不到1000条专家解答，在Qwen2.5-Instruct和Qwen3上实现10–25% pass@k提升，并将推理效率提升2–4倍。

method.training_loop: Stage 1 (offline): 用特权学生 M_PS(·|x,s) 预生成合成数据集 D_syn（直接采样或混合策略rollout，与训练完全解耦）。Stage 2: LoRA微调学生最小化对比损失 L(θ)，无RL循环。
method.loss_formulation: L(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{(x,r)\sim D_{syn}} \left[ \sum_{t=1}^{|r|} \left( D_{KL}(M_\theta(\cdot|x,r_{<t}) \| M_{PS}(\cdot|r_{<t})) - \gamma \cdot D_{KL}(M_\theta(\cdot|x,r_{<t}) \| M_{NR}(\cdot|r_{<t})) \right) \right]
method.data_source: e1-verifiable: AoPSWiki AIME 1985–2023历史题目（417题，Qwen2.5无法解决）；e1-proof: Evan Chen网站的669道奥林匹克证明题
key_components: Privileged Student (M_PS): 冻结的学生模型，以专家解答s为条件，生成在分布内的推理轨迹
Mixed Policy Rollouts: student与privileged student交替生成token（触发阈值τ=0.8），用于LRM（Qwen3）
Negative Reference (M_NR): 以删除中间推理步骤的粗粒度专家解答为条件的模型，构造捷径学习的负样本
Contrastive Objective: 正向KL拉近特权学生分布，负向KL推离负参考分布（γ=0.1）
LoRA Adapter: 学生更新存储为LoRA（r=32, α=32），与θ_ref共享基础权重

2602.02405.novelty: 传统蒸馏依赖更强的外部教师模型；DAIL无需外部教师，用学生自身（冻结）条件化专家解答生成在分布内轨迹，适用于前沿模型（无更强教师可用）。对比目标专门针对专家解答中的"跳步"捷径问题，STaR/SFT/RLVR均无法处理此场景（STaR在超难题上失败，RLVR面临zero-advantage问题，直接SFT导致OOD退化）。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: The above objective provides an off-policy, offline training framework that offers two primary efficiency advantages: (1) Asynchronous Data Generation: Unlike online RLVR approaches (Shao et al., 2024; Guo et al., 2025) that require interleaved generation and optimization, the in-distribution generation process is entirely decoupled from the training loop. This allows for massive parallelization of the dataset construction across distributed clusters before optimization.

opd_classification.reasoning: signal_source为self（冻结的学生自身以专家解答为条件），无外部教师模型，无verifier/reward，rollout在训练前一次性离线生成，属于self-signal离线KD。

training_setup.compute_budget: 4×A40 GPUs (DAIL); 4×H100 GPUs (GRPO baselines); DAIL ~0.1 H100 hr/epoch
stabilization_tricks: Frozen θ_ref as both privileged student and negative reference anchor

train: e1-proof (669 Olympiad proof problems, Evan Chen website)

key_findings: DAIL用不到1000条专家解答在AIME/Beyond AIME/IMO-AnswerBench上实现10–25% pass@k提升，同时Qwen3在IMO-AnswerBench获得约15%增益
DAIL推理效率提升2–4倍：以相同或更少token数达到与未训练模型相同的pass@k
DAIL计算效率远超GRPO：每epoch约0.1 H100小时 vs GRPO的277.6 H100小时，差距约2776倍
2602.02405.ablations_summary: 混合策略rollout对LRM（Qwen3）必不可少，对指令模型（Qwen2.5）直接采样更优；对比损失显著优于纯NLL（正向KD only）；仅最小化负向KL会降到基线以下（38.1 vs 41.0 pass@128）；γ=0.1和τ=0.8为最优超参数。
limitations: 需要学生模型具备基线推理能力，较弱模型（Qwen3-4B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B）效果不稳定
DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B指令跟随能力差，难以用定义好的prompt生成轨迹
混合策略rollout对超长LRM轨迹计算密集（截断至256 token）
γ超参数在Qwen2.5/Qwen3-8B上调优，较弱模型可能需要重新调参
failure_modes: 直接SFT专家解答导致推理性能严重退化（OOD分布问题）
STaR rationalization在问题难度超过模型基线能力时失败
τ≥0.99时混合策略生成的轨迹与直接采样类似且包含大量对参考解的引用（捷径）
仅用负向KL目标（无正向KD）导致性能低于基线

compute_efficiency.speedup_vs_baseline: ~2776× vs GRPO per epoch (0.1 vs 277.6 H100 hours)

theory.theoretical_claim: null

2602.02405.relevance_to_opd: DAIL是离线自蒸馏（self-signal，§5.3.2），无外部教师模型，student rollout在训练前一次性生成，不属于OPD（在线策略蒸馏）。其关键创新是将外部专家解答转化为在分布内的轨迹，与OPD的核心区别在于signal_source为self而非external-teacher。

2602.02482.title: Expanding the Capabilities of Reinforcement Learning via Text Feedback
2602.02482.summary: 提出RLTF框架，用文本反馈（text critique）作为RL训练信号，介于稀疏奖励和完整示范之间。核心方法RLTF-SD将教师对学生输出的文本反馈蒸馏回单轮策略，RLTF-FM将反馈预测作为辅助任务，均显著超越标准GRPO，并支持推理时多轮自我批改扩展。

method.training_loop: 每步采样N=8条rollout：(1) 学生生成第一轮回复y₀~π(·|x₀)；(2) 教师模型Qwen3-235B生成文本反馈c₀；(3) 构造x₁=f(x₀,y₀,c₀)，学生生成第二轮回复y₁~π(·|x₁)；(4) RLTF-SD：以(y₁→x₀)为蒸馏目标+第一轮mean baseline做AWR梯度；RLTF-FM：增加预测c₀的辅助SFT损失；两者均同时保留多轮RL目标。
method.loss_formulation: RLTF-SD: \ell_{distill}(\pi) = \mathbb{E}\left[\frac{\pi(y_1|x_0)}{\pi_{ref}(y_1|x_1)} \cdot A(x_0, y_1)\right], \quad A_i = R(x_0, y_1^i) - b(0); \quad b(0)=\frac{1}{N}\sum_j R(x_0, y_0^j). \quad \text{RLTF-FM: } \max J_{MultiTurn}(\pi) - \lambda_{FM}\cdot \ell_{FM}(\pi), \quad \ell_{FM}(\pi) = \mathbb{E}[-\log p_\pi(c_h|x_h,y_h)]
method.data_source: Reasoning Gym（Knights & Knaves / Binary Matrix / Shortest Path，各19.8K训练）；DAPO-17K竞赛数学；DeepMath-103K难题数学；LitBench-train（43K创意写作对）
key_components: Two-turn RLTF interaction protocol (student rollout → teacher text critique → second student rollout)
RLTF-SD: self-distillation from second-turn targets to first-turn policy using AWR (no importance weighting) with first-turn mean baseline
RLTF-FM: auxiliary feedback modeling loss (predict teacher critique as SFT objective)
First-turn group-mean baseline (avoids gradient-signal collapse when p₁→1)
AWR-style removal of importance weights (avoids log-ratio explosion ~142 on AIME24)

2602.02482.novelty: 与标准GRPO/多轮GRPO的区别：(1) 多轮GRPO仅将反馈作为上下文输入，对第一轮性能无改善；RLTF-SD通过蒸馏目标将反馈信号反向传递至第一轮策略，测试时无需反馈。(2) 与FeedbackDescent（文本空间优化）相比，RLTF在参数空间优化，效果更好。(3) 与拒绝采样蒸馏相比，显式引入第一轮基线避免collapse。(4) 理论上证明：稀疏奖励信号在低成功率时近秩1（SNR≤√ε₀），反馈预测可填补信号缺失方向。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: for each initial prompt x₀ we sample a first-turn output y₀ ~ π(·|x₀)... We then sample a revised output y₁ ~ π(·|x₁) where x₁ = f(x₀, y₀, c₀) incorporates the teacher critique c₀. Both rollouts are on-policy with respect to the current student policy, and the distillation objective updates π(·|x₀) using y₁ as targets with advantage A_i = R(x₀,y₁ⁱ) − b(0).

opd_classification.reasoning: 外部教师模型（Qwen3-235B）实时生成文本反馈指导学生在线rollout，属于external-teacher蒸馏；同时RLTF-FM包含自我预测反馈的辅助任务（self成分），故主体归§5.2（cross-size teacher→student蒸馏），次级含§5.3.2（self-distillation变体）。

stabilization_tricks: AWR-style (no importance weighting) to avoid log-ratio explosion
First-turn group-mean baseline to prevent gradient-signal collapse
Linear RL coefficient schedule 0→0.1 for math tasks

key_findings: RLTF-FM在推理任务上大幅超越标准GRPO：Knights & Knaves单轮准确率从0.373提升至0.880，Shortest Path从0.385提升至0.905，证明文本反馈对逃离局部最优关键。
多轮GRPO（将反馈仅作为上下文）对第一轮性能无改善（K&K: 0.352 vs GRPO单轮0.373），而RLTF-SD/FM通过蒸馏目标成功将反馈信号内化到第一轮策略。
重要性加权在LLM上不可行：AIME24轨迹级对数重要性比值均值为142.16，AWR（移除IS权重）+第一轮基线是唯一稳定选择；第二轮基线导致梯度信号崩溃（当p₁→1时更新概率趋近零）。
2602.02482.ablations_summary: 关键设计选择消融（Figure 2）：(1) 第一轮基线 vs 第二轮基线：第二轮基线导致signal collapse，第一轮基线为必要条件；(2) AWR（无IS权重）vs PPO clipping vs CISPO clipping：AWR表现最优，IS方法因log-ratio过大均不稳定；(3) 反馈质量消融（Figure 3）：正确率反馈（correctness-only）显著弱于语义丰富文本反馈，证明文本信息量本身不可或缺；(4) RLTF-FM额外消融（Figure 5）：仅做自我批改RL（无FM损失）对测试时多轮扩展无改善，FM辅助任务是推理时扩展的关键。
limitations: 真实世界反馈可能含噪声或主观性，需要数据过滤和筛选流程
长时域交互中反馈摘要和分布偏移问题未解决
理论分析局限于冻结rollout和对数线性策略的批量RL设定，无端到端分析
与过程奖励模型（PRM）的结合尚未探索
failure_modes: 第二轮基线导致梯度信号崩溃：当post-feedback成功率p₁→1时，非零更新概率≤N(1-p₁)趋近0
重要性加权爆炸：AIME24轨迹级log比值均值142.16，全IS校正数值不稳定
标准GRPO在Shortest Path任务陷入退化局部最优（无论输入均输出'infeasible'），无文本反馈无法逃脱
RLTF-FM在创意写作任务中弱于RLTF-SD，原因是主观反馈难以预测

theory.theoretical_claim: Sparse reward RL faces near-rank-1 gradient signal (SNR≤√ε₀) requiring Ω(1/ε₀) rollouts to recover gradient sign; RLTF-FM provides non-trivial movement in low-signal subspace via feedback modeling term with lower bound ρ²λ²(Tγ_FM·k + T²b_FM²)
theory.proof_sketch: Lemma C.2: sparse reward SNR bound ≤√ε₀; Theorem C.1: progress in S_low(η) bounded by success-conditioned second moment; Theorem C.2: RLTF-FM induces E[||Π(w_T-w₀)||²] ≥ ρ²λ²(Tγ_FM·k + T²b_FM²) under coverage+drift assumptions, showing FM fills directions invisible to reward-only RL

2602.02482.relevance_to_opd: 直接相关：Qwen3-235B外部教师在每个训练步实时生成文本批评，指导Llama-3.1-8B学生的在线rollout；属于典型OPD场景（外部教师→在线学生）。创新在于反馈信号是自然语言而非logits/reward，且通过蒸馏目标（RLTF-SD）和辅助预测任务（RLTF-FM）将反馈内化，避免测试时依赖教师。

2602.00400.title: KEPO: Knowledge-Enhanced Preference Optimization for Reinforcement Learning with Reasoning
2602.00400.summary: 提出KEPO框架，通过质量门控的在线蒸馏（仅对高奖励轨迹应用教师监督）和知识增强探索（教师生成hint辅助拒绝采样以注入奖励正轨迹），解决稀疏奖励RL中的credit assignment歧义和探索崩溃问题，应用于医学VQA多模态推理任务。

method.training_loop: 每步从student π_θ采样G=8条轨迹；若max reward=0则触发知识增强探索：教师生成hint h，学生在(x,h,y*)条件下拒绝采样直到r>0或达预算B；将注入的hint轨迹与普通轨迹合并，计算KEPO目标：GRPO式RL项 + 质量门控蒸馏项（仅r_i≥τ的轨迹做KL teacher→student）+ KL正则项，反向传播更新θ。
method.loss_formulation: J_{KEPO}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{x,y_{1:G}\sim\pi_{\theta_{old}}} \left[ \sum_{i=1}^G w_i(\theta)\hat{A}_i - \mathbf{1}_{r_i \geq \tau} D_T(\pi_T \| \pi_\theta)(y_i|x) - \beta D_{KL}(\pi_\theta(\cdot|x) \| \pi_{ref}(\cdot|x)) \right]
method.data_source: OmniMedVQA开放子集中的MRI图像-问题对（600条训练样本），Qwen3-VL-32B教师模型实时生成hint
key_components: quality-gated on-policy distillation (indicator I_{r_i≥τ})
knowledge-enhanced exploration via teacher hint + rejection sampling
GRPO-style advantage-weighted policy optimization
KL regularization against reference policy

2602.00400.novelty: 与GKD/VOLD等均匀在线蒸馏的关键区别：(1)质量门控——只对reward≥τ的轨迹施加蒸馏，避免在低质量/错误推理链上的噪声梯度；(2)自适应知识增强探索——在全零奖励时由教师生成hint触发拒绝采样，主动向rollout buffer注入奖励正轨迹，而非依赖静态演示或外部PRM。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: For each input x, the student policy π_θ first performs standard on-policy rollout by sampling a group of G trajectories {y_i}^G_{i=1} ~ π_θ(·|x). If max_i r(y_i) = 0, the rollout is deemed unsuccessful and knowledge-enhanced exploration mechanism is triggered... The accepted hint-aware trajectories are injected into the rollout buffer and jointly optimized with standard on-policy trajectories under the KEPO objective.

opd_classification.reasoning: 学生在训练循环内实时rollout，教师提供dense logit蒸馏信号（质量门控KL）且同时提供hint辅助探索，属于有外部教师模型的在线策略蒸馏（§5.2），hint拒绝采样中亦使用GT answer作为PI信号（§5.3.1特征），但主导机制是external-teacher蒸馏。

eval: OmniMedVQA (8 modalities: MRI, CT, X-Ray, Ultrasound, Dermatology, Fundus, OCT, Microscopy)

key_findings: KEPO(τ=1, Thinking, 2B)在OmniMedVQA整体平均准确率80.25%，超过16倍参数量的Qwen3-VL-32B教师模型(79.33%)。
均匀在线蒸馏(On-policy KD Thinking)严重降低推理性能（整体65.92% vs GRPO Thinking 74.33%），验证了对低质量轨迹蒸馏注入噪声梯度的假设。
质量门控(τ=1)相比τ=0提供更稳定的收敛曲线（OOD平均75.24% vs 74.76%），完整KEPO通过知识增强探索进一步提升至78.00% OOD。
2602.00400.ablations_summary: 对比KEPO-KE（仅质量门控蒸馏，无hint探索）和完整KEPO：KEPO-KE改善了早期OOD收敛速度，但存在后期性能退化；完整KEPO通过hint拒绝采样持续降低探索崩溃，OOD最终准确率更高。τ=0与τ=1对比：τ=0早期峰值可能更高但优化不稳定；τ=1最终表现更平稳且在大多数OOD模态上更优。
limitations: 仅在单一基准OmniMedVQA上评估，泛化性未验证
单源训练设置（仅MRI训练）限制了对更广泛训练分布的理解
训练集仅600样本，可能不反映大规模部署场景
拒绝采样预算B未做消融分析
需要强大教师模型(Qwen3-VL-32B)，增加训练时推理开销
SFT与RFT结合的原则性方法尚不清晰，留待未来工作
failure_modes: 均匀on-policy蒸馏在思考模式下导致严重性能退化（65.92% overall），因低质量推理链上的蒸馏注入噪声梯度
纯GRPO在稀疏奖励下出现'learning cliff'：早期策略极少发现奖励正轨迹导致探索停滞

theory.theoretical_claim: null

2602.00400.relevance_to_opd: KEPO是典型的OPD方法：学生在训练循环内实时采样轨迹，外部教师模型提供dense logit蒸馏信号（质量门控KL散度）；核心创新是通过质量门控限制蒸馏范围（仅高奖励轨迹）以及用教师hint辅助拒绝采样解决探索崩溃，属于外部教师驱动的在线策略蒸馏（§5.2）。

2601.18734.title: Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models
2601.18734.affiliation_primary: UCLA (Siyan Zhao, Aditya Grover) / Meta (Zhihui Xie, Mengchen Liu, Jing Huang, Guan Pang, Feiyu Chen)
2601.18734.summary: 提出On-Policy Self-Distillation（OPSD）框架：同一LLM同时扮演teacher和student，teacher条件化于ground-truth solution y⋆，student仅看问题x并在线采样轨迹，训练目标为最小化student rollout上的per-token KL/JSD散度。无需外部teacher模型，实现8-12×于GRPO的token效率。

method.training_loop: 1) 采样minibatch (x, y⋆); 2) student在线采样ŷ∼p_S(·|x); 3) 同一模型以两种conditioning计算next-token分布：p_S(·|x,ŷ_{<n})和p_T(·|x,y⋆,ŷ_{<n}); 4) 计算per-token JSD_β散度; 5) 仅对student logits反传梯度; teacher policy固定为初始策略(不随训练更新)
method.data_source: OpenThoughts数学推理子集，最多30K条problem-solution对（含chain-of-thought reasoning）
key_components: 同一模型双重conditioning（student仅见问题，teacher见问题+ground-truth solution）
在线on-policy student rollout采样
per-token full-vocabulary divergence（JSD）目标
teacher policy固定为初始策略（隐式正则化）
LoRA微调（rank=64，alpha=128）
Sampled-token policy-gradient alternative objective（reverse-KL advantage）

2601.18734.novelty: 相比GKD（Agarwal et al., 2024）等on-policy distillation方法，OPSD无需外部独立teacher模型——teacher和student共享同一参数θ，仅通过conditioning context区分；相比GRPO等RLVR，OPSD提供dense per-token supervision而非sparse sequence-level reward；相比off-policy SFT，消除distribution shift。核心创新在于利用ground-truth solution y⋆作为privileged information实现self-distillation。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: We preserve the on-policy training paradigm by sampling trajectories ŷ exclusively from the student policy, which then receives dense, token-level supervision from the privileged teacher policy. [...] The teacher policy conditions on privileged information—both the problem x and the reference solution y⋆: p_T(·|x,y⋆) ≜ p_θ(·|x,y⋆). The student policy observes only the problem statement, matching the inference-time condition: p_S(·|x) ≜ p_θ(·|x). Both policies share the same parameters θ but differ only in their conditioning context.

opd_classification.reasoning: teacher与student共享同一模型参数θ（is_self=true），teacher信号来源是ground-truth solution y⋆作为privileged information（PI(GT)），而非外部独立teacher模型；轨迹在训练循环内实时采样（on-policy）→ §5.3.2（self only / same-model self-distillation with PI(GT) privileged context）

stabilization_tricks: teacher policy固定为初始策略（不随训练更新，隐式正则化）

train: OpenThoughts (math subset, up to 30K problem-solution pairs with CoT)

key_findings: OPSD在Qwen3-4B/8B上匹配或超越GRPO（4B平均50.4% vs GRPO 49.6%，8B平均52.2% vs GRPO 51.3%），同时仅需1个rollout/prompt（GRPO需8个）。
OPSD比GRPO实现8-12×的token效率提升：OPSD每个generation限制1024 tokens，GRPO需要16384 tokens，但最终性能相当。
Full-vocabulary logit distillation优于sampled-token policy gradient：AIME25 84.1% vs 82.1%，HMMT25 60.0% vs 57.3%；1.7B规模下OPSD表现不如GRPO，表明self-distillation需要足够模型容量。
2601.18734.ablations_summary: 三组消融：(1) 模型规模：1.7B/4B/8B三个尺度验证self-distillation随容量增大效果增强（1.7B下OPSD低于GRPO）；(2) generation length：1024/2048/4096 tokens，更长生成提供更多teacher signal，2k/4k显著优于1k；(3) 学习目标：full-vocabulary logit distillation vs sampled-token policy gradient，前者在AIME25和HMMT25上均更优，代价是更高peak memory。
limitations: 实验仅限于8B参数以内模型，更大规模（70B+）的效果未知
当前框架未显式利用生成答案的correctness验证，仅依赖distribution matching
当问题难度超过模型理解阈值时，teacher policy即使有y⋆也无法提供有效supervision
Full-vocabulary logit distillation需要存储vocabulary-size logits，内存开销更高
failure_modes: Qwen3-1.7B规模下OPSD在HMMT25上性能下降（相比base instruct），表明模型容量不足时self-distillation信号有噪
当所有sampled trajectories均错误时，sampled-token policy gradient variant的学习信号消失（与GRPO相同的vanishing gradient问题）

theory.theoretical_claim: OPSD目标等价于dense-reward policy gradient：per-token reward r_n = log p_T(ŷ_n|x,y⋆,ŷ_{<n}) − log p_S(ŷ_n|x,ŷ_{<n})；STaR等价于sequence-level binary reward policy gradient（all-token same signal，vanishes when all incorrect）
theory.proof_sketch: 附录C通过log-derivative trick推导STaR和OPSD均可写为policy gradient形式，区别在于reward结构：STaR为1(y=y⋆)序列级指示函数；OPSD为每token位置的teacher-student log-prob差值。

2601.18734.relevance_to_opd: 本文即OPD领域的核心方法论贡献：在无外部teacher的极端场景下实现on-policy distillation，通过同一模型的privileged-context conditioning替代外部teacher，属于§5.3.2 self-distillation分支；直接与Lu&Lab(2025)的on-policy distillation和Agarwal et al.(2024)的GKD形成方法对比。

2601.19897.title: Self-Distillation Enables Continual Learning
2601.19897.summary: SDFT（Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning）是一种 on-policy 学习方法，利用同一模型的 in-context learning 能力：以 demonstration 为条件的版本作为 teacher，无 demonstration 的版本作为 student，最小化两者之间的反向 KL 散度，实现在习得新技能/知识的同时显著减轻灾难性遗忘。

method.training_loop: 每步采样 minibatch (x_i, c_i)；student 以 π_θ(·|x_i) 在线采样轨迹 y_i；teacher 使用同一模型参数的 EMA 版本 π_ϕ(·|x_i,c_i)（conditioned on demonstration）；计算 per-token 解析 KL 梯度 ∇_θ L(θ)；更新 student 参数 θ←θ-ηg；EMA 更新 teacher ϕ←αθ+(1-α)ϕ。
method.loss_formulation: L(\theta) = D_{KL}(\pi_\theta(\cdot|x) \| \pi(\cdot|x,c)) = \mathbb{E}_{y\sim\pi_\theta(\cdot|x)}\left[\sum_t \log\frac{\pi_\theta(y_t|y_{<t},x)}{\pi(y_t|y_{<t},x,c)}\right]
method.data_source: Science Q&A: SciKnowEval Chemistry L-3子集（GPT-4o生成demonstrations）；Tool Use: ToolAlpaca；Medical: HuatuoGPT-o1英文子集（~20K样本）；Knowledge Acquisition: Wikipedia 2025自然灾害文章（~200K tokens，GPT-5生成QA对）
key_components: Demonstration-conditioned self-teacher (in-context learning as teacher signal)
On-policy student rollout per training step
EMA teacher parameter update (ϕ←αθ+(1-α)ϕ)
Analytic per-token KL gradient estimator
Loss masking on first few tokens to suppress learned artifacts

2601.19897.novelty: 相比 SFT（离线）和传统知识蒸馏（独立 teacher/student），SDFT 是首个将 in-context learning 能力转化为 on-policy 自蒸馏信号的方法：teacher 与 student 共用同一模型参数（EMA），通过 demonstration conditioning 获得比 student 更优的分布，无需显式 reward 函数或外部 teacher 模型。数学上等价于最大化隐式奖励 r(y,x,c)=log π(y|x,c)−log π_k(y|x)。与 GRPO 等 RL 方法相比，无需 group sampling，每 prompt 仅需单次在线生成。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: SDFT leverages a model's in-context learning ability to generate on-policy training signals. For each query x, the model acts in two roles. As student that is conditioned only on the query P=π(·|x) and the teacher, which is the same model conditioned on an expert demonstration c, producing a demonstration-aware distribution Q = π(·|x,c). Training minimizes the reverse KL divergence between the student and teacher, yielding on-policy updates.

opd_classification.reasoning: Teacher 是同一模型自身以 demonstration 为条件的版本（self），signal_source=PI(demos)，属于自蒸馏 on-policy；无外部独立 teacher 模型，无 verifier/RLVR，signal 来自 self（EMA 参数）conditioned on demos，归入 §5.3.2（self on-policy）。

training_setup.compute_budget: Single NVIDIA H200 GPU per experiment; 2.5× FLOPs vs SFT, 4× wall-clock time vs SFT
stabilization_tricks: Loss masking on first few tokens
Cosine LR schedule with 10 warmup steps

key_findings: SDFT 在 Science Q&A 新任务准确率达 70.2%（vs SFT 66.2%），同时先验任务保留 64.5%（vs SFT 53.4%，高 +11.1pp），证明 on-policy 自蒸馏可同时提升新任务性能并大幅减轻灾难性遗忘。
知识获取任务中，SDFT OOD 准确率达 98%（vs SFT 80%，+18pp），几乎追平 Oracle RAG（100%），显示对分布外知识的真正泛化能力。
规模效应显著：3B 模型 SDFT 无优势，7B 提升 +4.0%，14B 提升 +7.0%，表明方法随模型 ICL 能力增强而受益递增。
2601.19897.ablations_summary: On-policy 训练是核心：离线蒸馏优于 SFT 但劣于 SDFT；EMA teacher 优于 frozen teacher 和当前 student 作 teacher（后者导致训练发散）；full demonstration context（text+answers）远优于仅 answers（89% vs 37%）；analytic per-token KL 估计器优于 Rao-Blackwellized 和 partial estimator；多轨迹采样无收益但显著增加计算开销。
limitations: Student 可能从 teacher 继承虚假语言模式（如 'Based on the text...'），目前以 loss masking 启发式缓解，根本解决方案尚未提出。
方法有效性严重依赖基础模型的 in-context learning 能力，3B 小模型效果不显著。
尽管大幅减轻，仍存在部分灾难性遗忘（如 Medical 任务 IFEval 下降 9.9pp）。
计算成本 2.5× FLOPs / 4× wall-clock vs SFT，在资源受限场景有局限。
当目标行为需要根本性转变生成模式时效果有限（如将非推理模型转为 chain-of-thought 模型较困难）。
failure_modes: Depth collapse：SFT 在 Olmo-3-7B-Think 上导致推理深度骤降（-29%，3273 tokens），准确率下降 7.7pp；SDFT 维持深度（-9.4%）并提升准确率。
ICL 能力弱时（3B 模型）teacher 信号质量不足，SDFT 无法优于 SFT。
demonstration 仅含 answers 而无 context text 时，knowledge acquisition 严格准确率骤降至 37%（vs full context 89%）。

theory.theoretical_claim: SDFT 在 ICL 近似最优策略假设下，等价于最大化隐式奖励 r(y,x,c)=log π(y|x,c)−log π_k(y|x) 的 trust-region RL 目标；token 级奖励之和等于轨迹奖励。
theory.proof_sketch: 从 trust-region RL 最优策略闭合形式 π*∝π_k·exp(r/β)，令 π(·|x,c)≈π*，反解出隐式奖励；再证明对该奖励的策略梯度等价于 reverse KL 散度 D_KL(π_θ||π(·|x,c)) 的梯度。

2601.19897.relevance_to_opd: SDFT 是典型的 self on-policy distillation（§5.3.2）：teacher 与 student 共用参数（EMA），信号来自 PI(demos) 而非外部 teacher 或 verifier；与 OPD 框架的核心区别在于 teacher 是通过 in-context conditioning 而非独立更大模型实现，提供了一种无外部 teacher 的 on-policy 知识转移路径。

2601.16547.title: CORD: Bridging the Audio–Text Reasoning Gap via Weighted On-policy Cross-modal Distillation
2601.16547.summary: CORD是一个统一的在线跨模态自蒸馏框架，在单一LALM内以文本模态作为内部教师，沿音频模态的实时rollout轨迹，通过重要性加权反向KL（token级）和基于judge的GRPO（序列级）对音频推理进行对齐，用80k数学合成数据平均减少41.6%的音频-文本性能差距。

method.training_loop: 1) 对每个音频输入xa采样on-policy轨迹y~pθ(·|xa)；2) token级：计算每步反向KL散度Dt=KL(pθ(·|y<t,xa)‖pθ(·|y<t,xt))，取top-K(K=20)高散度token赋权α，同时用位置线性衰减权wpos，联合加权后计算Ltok；3) 序列级：对每个xa采样N=4条轨迹，每条由judge模型打分（与文本参考答案语义一致→r=1），GRPO计算相对优势并优化Lseq；4) 联合优化LCORD=Ltok+Lseq。
method.loss_formulation: L_{CORD} = L_{tok} + L_{seq}, \quad L_{tok} = \mathbb{E}_{y \sim p_\theta(\cdot|x^a)} \left[ \sum_{t=1}^T w_t D_t \right], \quad w_t = w_t^{KL} \cdot w_t^{pos}, \quad L_{seq} = -\mathbb{E} \left[ \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N A^{(i)} \log p_\theta(y^{(i)} | x^a) \right]
method.data_source: NuminaMath（80,000条数学问题），通过Kokoro TTS模型合成对应音频，构建文本-音频等语义输入对
key_components: On-policy audio-conditioned rollout sampling
Weighted reverse KL token-level alignment (Top-K importance + positional decay)
Judge-based sequence-level GRPO reward
Internal text modality as in-model teacher (no external teacher)

2601.16547.novelty: 与BLSP-KD、Cuervo et al.等off-policy KD方法不同，CORD在学生自身音频推理轨迹上执行蒸馏，避免teacher rollout与student实际inference state的分布偏移；引入top-K KL加权+位置衰减权重解决uniform KL梯度稀释问题；teacher为模型内部文本模态而非外部独立模型，无需额外推理开销；GRPO序列级对齐与token级on-policy KD联合训练，防止GRPO单独使用时的模型崩溃。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: CORD aligns the model's cross-modal behavior along trajectories sampled from its current policy. For each x^a, we sample y ~ p_θ(·|x^a) to obtain an on-policy decoding trajectory. At each step t, the model induces two distributions over the vocabulary V conditioned on the same prefix y<t: p_θ(·|y<t, x^a) and p_θ(·|y<t, x^t). To quantify the discrepancy at each state, we employ Reverse KL Divergence... CORDleveragesthemodel'sinternaltextmodalityasanin-modelteacherandconductsmulti-granularity distillation along the student model's real audio-conditioned reasoning trajectories.

opd_classification.reasoning: teacher信号来源为模型自身的文本模态（self），无外部teacher模型，轨迹在训练循环内实时采样（on-policy），属于self on-policy蒸馏（§5.3.2）；序列级GRPO部分用内部judge模型评分，带有verifier性质可归入§5.3.3。

stabilization_tricks: On-policy distillation token-level KL as GRPO regularizer to prevent collapse
Temperature 1.5 for GRPO rollouts to encourage diversity

train: NuminaMath (80k synthetic audio-text pairs via Kokoro TTS)

key_findings: CORD在Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct上将音频-文本模态差距平均减少41.6%，在Step-Audio2-mini上减少44.8%，显著优于SFT和Forward-KL基线。
单独使用GRPO在1000步后出现严重模型崩溃（GSM8K从35.59降至19.89），加入on-policy KD（OPD模块）可完全消除崩溃并稳定训练至3000步。
尽管仅在数学数据集上训练，CORD在MMSU和OBQA等通用领域基准上表现出跨域泛化，说明其学习的是可迁移的跨模态对齐能力而非领域特定知识。
2601.16547.ablations_summary: 消融表明：GRPO单独使用不稳定（1000步后崩溃）；加入OPD后训练稳定且GSM8K恢复至36.12；完整CORD（GRPO+OPD+加权）进一步提升MMSU至38.06、OBQA至52.77，平均高出基线6.35分。超参数敏感性分析表明α=β=2.0为最优，过大（2.5）或过小（1.0）均有性能下降。
limitations: 仅在单一数学数据集（NuminaMath）上训练，多样性受限；作者明确指出期待引入更多领域数据以增强泛化。
需要TTS合成的配对音频文本数据，数据构建依赖TTS质量。
judge模型用于GRPO评分，其质量依赖于蒸馏的专有前沿模型，存在一定不透明性。
failure_modes: 单独使用GRPO在1000训练步时发生模型崩溃，GSM8K性能从35.59降至19.89，低于基线20.73。
Forward-KL基线在MMAU音乐和声音类别上产生灾难性遗忘，性能下降约3分。
SFT基线在GSM8K上反而扩大模态差距（gap从19.74增至6.79↓ → 实际gap为6.79但text baseline为40.47，说明GSM8K音频性能反而提升，但OBQA gap增大1.71）。

theory.theoretical_claim: null

2601.16547.relevance_to_opd: CORD是典型的self on-policy蒸馏（OPD §5.3.2）：student即teacher（同一模型的文本模态），轨迹在训练循环内实时采样，用反向KL对齐音频rollout到文本分布；同时结合GRPO序列级奖励，揭示纯OPD对训练稳定性的关键正则化作用（防止GRPO崩溃），是跨模态场景下OPD的重要扩展案例。

2601.08310.title: ORBIT: On-policy Exploration-Exploitation for Controllable Multi-Budget Reasoning
2601.08310.summary: ORBIT enables a single LLM to generate responses across four discrete reasoning modes (Low/Mid/High/Xhigh) controlled by system prompts. It uses (1) an Expansion-Compression Loop with sequential per-mode RLVR to discover Pareto-frontier expert policies, and (2) Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation with model-merging initialization to fuse all experts into one unified model.

method.training_loop: Phase 1 (Exploration): For each mode k, run GRPO with context window first expanded (Lexp), then halved logarithmically (32K→16K→8K→4K) until policy re-equilibrates → K expert models {πθk}. Phase 2 (Exploitation): Merge all K experts by parameter averaging → student init ϕ. Run OPD: sample rollout o~πϕ(·|q,pk), minimize RKL loss vs. teacher πθk per mode, repeat.
method.loss_formulation: L_{fusion}(\phi) = \mathbb{E}_{k \sim U(1,K)} \mathbb{E}_{q \sim \mathcal{D},\, o \sim \pi_\phi(\cdot|q,p_k)} \left[ \sum_t \log \frac{\pi_\phi(o_t|q,p_k,o_{<t})}{\pi_{\theta_k}(o_t|q,p_k,o_{<t})} \right]
method.data_source: DAPO-Math-17K (for 1.5B model); Polaris-53K (for 4B and 7B models)
key_components: Expansion-Compression Loop (ECL) with logarithmic context scheduling
Sequential per-mode RLVR (GRPO) to prevent mode collapse
Model-merging cold-start initialization (parameter averaging of K experts)
Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation with Reverse KL objective
Mode-specific system prompts (Low/Mid/High/Xhigh)

2601.08310.novelty: Prior adaptive-effort methods (Ada-R1, AdaCOT, O1-Pruner) bake a fixed trade-off into training; prompt steering of vanilla LRMs yields no genuine mode separation (Table 5). Joint multi-mode RL causes mode collapse (Figure 3). Offline distillation causes exposure bias. ORBIT uniquely combines: (1) sequential per-mode RL with logarithmic context compression to obtain Pareto-frontier experts, and (2) on-policy RKL distillation with merged initialization to fuse them without distribution mismatch.

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: we adopt On-Policy Distillation (Agarwal et al., 2023; Lu and Lab, 2025), minimizing the Reverse Kullback-Leibler (RKL) divergence: L_distill(ϕ) = E_{q~D, o~πϕ(·|q,pk)} [log(πϕ(o|q,pk) / πθk(o|q,pk))]. RKL is inherently mode-seeking, encouraging the student πϕ to focus on the high-density reasoning modes of the expert πθk under prompt pk for mode ck.

opd_classification.reasoning: The exploitation phase is explicitly on-policy distillation from K external teacher expert models (produced by per-mode RL) using student rollouts and Reverse KL loss per step; exploration phase uses RLVR with verifiable math rewards.

stabilization_tricks: Rejection sampling (DAPO recipe) to prevent oscillation under aggressive truncation
Higher PPO-style clipping per DAPO recipe
Model-merging cold-start to prevent OPD cold-start failure

key_findings: ORBIT Low on 1.5B achieves ~7.6× token reduction (2.0K vs 15.2K tokens) at comparable overall accuracy (26.5% vs 25.0% initial), while ORBIT Xhigh raises AIME24 from 28.6% to 42.6% within the same unified model.

ORBIT Xhigh on Qwen3-4B recovers and slightly exceeds the initial model baseline (82.6% vs 81.6% on AIME24) while adding a Low mode that uses only 3.3K tokens vs. 20.1K — a 6.1× range in a single unified model.

Prompt steering on the initial model yields no genuine mode separation (68.0–71.0% overall with non-monotonic token usage), confirming that ORBIT's specialized RL training is necessary for Pareto-frontier mode control.
2601.08310.ablations_summary: Joint multi-mode RL causes mode collapse (Mid/High/Xhigh converge); sequential per-mode ECL prevents it. On-policy distillation slightly outperforms offline distillation and enables adaptive convergence. Model-merging initialization significantly reduces Accumulated Misalignment Rate and per-token RKL penalty throughout OPD training, accelerating convergence vs. final-stage-only init.
limitations: Long-form RL-based training is computationally expensive and may not scale to very large models or extremely long contexts.
Low model output entropy leads to low on-policy sample efficiency, limiting further compression progress.
Evaluated only on reasoning tasks with rule-based verifiable correctness signals; not extended to open-ended or difficult-to-verify tasks.
No theoretical convergence or optimality guarantees for the proposed training procedure.
failure_modes: Joint multi-mode RL training causes mode collapse: Mid/High/Xhigh converge to nearly identical behaviors (Figure 3).
Without model-merging cold-start, OPD suffers from low-confidence rollouts that rarely reach the expert's high-density manifold, limiting supervisory signal.
Aggressive context truncation without rejection sampling causes training oscillation.

theory.theoretical_claim: Logarithmic compression schedule justified by heavy-tailed trajectory length distribution: multiplicative schedule L_{k+1}=ρL_k gives constant relative truncation pressure ρ^{-α} (independent of k), unlike additive schedules; truncation objective decomposed into two coupled terms (valid-trajectory probability mass × semantic quality).
theory.proof_sketch: Under heavy-tailed S(L)=CL^{-α}, ratio S(L_{k+1})/S(L_k)=ρ^{-α} is constant for multiplicative schedule but grows as L_k decreases for additive schedule. No formal convergence proofs provided.

2601.08310.relevance_to_opd: ORBIT's exploitation phase is a direct instantiation of multi-teacher on-policy distillation: the student generates its own rollouts each step and minimizes Reverse KL against K external expert teachers (themselves RL-trained on the same base model), explicitly addressing exposure bias in offline KD. The exploration phase is RLVR with verifiable math rewards. The paper is a clean primary example of §5.2 OPD from external teacher models.

2601.07155.title: Stable On-Policy Distillation through Adaptive Target Reformulation
2601.07155.summary: 提出Veto，一种on-policy知识蒸馏的目标函数级重构方法：在logit空间构造教师与学生的几何中间分布Q∝P_T·P_S^β，用β参数同时解决forward KL梯度爆炸和reverse KL模式崩塌问题，并在GSM8K、HumanEval、DialogSum上超越现有on-policy基线。

method.training_loop: for step i=1..N: β←β·(1-i/N); x~X; y~P_θ(·|x) (student rollout); for each token t: z_T=logP_T, z_S=logP_θ, Q∝exp(z_T+β·z_S); L_t=D_KL(Q‖P_θ) [fwd] or D_KL(P_θ‖Q) [rev]; θ←θ-η∇L
method.loss_formulation: L = E_{x~P_data, y~P_S(·|x)} [\sum_{t=1}^{|y|} D_{KL}(Q(\cdot|x,y_{<t}) \| P_S(\cdot|x,y_{<t}))], \text{ where } Q(y|x) \propto P_T(y|x) \cdot P_S(y|x)^{\beta}
method.data_source: GSM8K（7K教师SFT，1K学生训练）；WizardCoder（10K教师SFT，1K学生训练）；DialogSum（10K教师SFT，1K学生训练）
key_components: Product-of-Experts中间目标分布 Q∝P_T·P_S^β
β线性衰减调度（从β到0）
Adaptive Gradient Veto（forward KL梯度抑制）
Decisiveness Knob（reverse KL熵正则化控制）
学生在线采样（on-policy rollout）

2601.07155.novelty: 与GKD/MiniLLM/SKD等prior work相比，Veto在目标函数层面而非数据混合层面解决分布不匹配：不混合数据样本，而是在logit空间构造几何中间分布，用单一标量β统一处理forward KL梯度爆炸和reverse KL模式崩塌，并提供理论保证（Theorem 1-3）。SKD通过交织采样修正低质样本，而Veto不改变采样策略，只修改优化目标。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: on-policy KD (Agarwal et al., 2024) aligns the training distribution with the student's inference distribution by sampling sequences y = (y1, ..., yT) directly from the student's own policy P_S(·|x). Formally, for a given prompt x, the objective is to minimize the expected token-level divergence along these self-generated trajectories: L = E_{x~P_data, y~P_S(·|x)} [ Σ_{t=1}^{|y|} D_KL(P_T(·|x,y_{<t}) ∥ P_S(·|x,y_{<t})) ]. By receiving feedback on its own mistakes, the student learns to correct its behavior within the specific regions of the probability space it is likely to visit during test time.

opd_classification.reasoning: 学生在训练循环内实时rollout，teacher提供token-level logits作为监督信号，属于external-teacher的on-policy蒸馏方法（§5.2范畴）。

key_findings: Veto在GSM8K上将on-policy KD从35.1%提升至39.9%（+4.8%），超越所有基线包括Supervised KD（33.4%）和SKD（33.6%）。
β线性衰减策略优于常数β：初始β=0.8逐渐衰减至0，在early stage抑制pathological gradients，late stage充分学习teacher分布细节。
Veto对数据生成策略无关（Supervised KD/SKD/On-policy KD + Veto均有改善）且对KL方向无关（forward和reverse KL均有效），Gemma2模型族验证跨模型泛化性。
2601.07155.ablations_summary: 消融实验涵盖：(1)数据生成策略×Veto（三种数据策略均受益，on-policy最大+4.8%）；(2)KL方向×Veto（forward +4.8%，reverse +2.3%）；(3)β调度策略（线性衰减>常数β，初始β=0.8最优）；(4)跨模型族（Gemma2验证泛化性）。
limitations: 学生训练数据规模较小（仅1K实例），实验规模有限，未在更大模型或更多任务上验证。
β超参数需要grid search选择，增加了调参成本（不同任务最优β不同：reasoning/code β=0.8，summarization β=0.3）。
failure_modes: Forward KL在early training阶段学生对teacher偏好token概率接近0时出现梯度爆炸（P_T(y)/P_S(y)发散）。
Reverse KL缺乏控制mode-seeking强度的机制，standard on-policy KD常导致多样性崩塌（premature mode collapse）。

theory.theoretical_claim: Theorem 1: Veto的loss在P_S→0时收敛至0（梯度不爆炸）；Theorem 2: 学生收敛到P_T^{1/(1-β)}的sharper分布（隐式温度缩放T=1-β）；Theorem 3: Reverse KL + Veto的梯度等价于带熵正则化的REINFORCE策略梯度
theory.proof_sketch: Theorem 1用L'Hôpital极限证明P_S^β·logP_S在P_S→0时趋于0；Theorem 2通过最优点P_S*=Q的不动点方程推导P_S*∝P_T^{1/(1-β)}；Theorem 3将D_KL(P_S‖Q)的梯度展开，识别出reward项logP_T和scaled entropy cost项(1-β)logP_S

2601.07155.relevance_to_opd: 核心论文：直接研究on-policy蒸馏的稳定性问题，提出logit空间Product-of-Experts中间目标Q=P_T·P_S^β，通过β线性衰减在训练全程动态调整teacher-student gap，是OPD稳定化方向的代表性方法。

2512.23097.title: A Note on Hybrid Online Reinforcement and Imitation Learning for LLMs: Formulations and Algorithms
2512.23097.summary: 提出统一框架，将 LLM 的 KL 散度最小化与奖励最大化组合为混合目标，证明其梯度可精确分解为 Dense（解析的 token 级模仿）与 Sparse（蒙特卡洛的长时奖励）两项，并给出 logit 级高效实现公式。

method.training_loop: 每轮: 采样 prompt x; 用当前 student π_θ 生成 K 条响应 (group rollout); 计算每步 token 级 log-ratio c_t; 计算轨迹奖励 R; 计算折扣 future return G_{t+1}; 累积 Dense gradient (logit 级解析式) + Sparse gradient (REINFORCE policy gradient); 按 K 平均后更新 θ
method.loss_formulation: J(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{x \sim \mathcal{D}} \left[ D_{\mathrm{KL}}(\pi_\theta(\cdot|x) \| \pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(\cdot|x)) - \lambda \mathbb{E}_{y \sim \pi_\theta}[r(x,y)] \right]
method.data_source: 无外部训练数据；从当前 student 策略 on-policy 采样
key_components: Gradient Decomposition Theorem (Dense + Sparse)
Logit-level KL gradient formula (Proposition 5)
Group rollout (GRPO/RLOO 兼容)
Discounted future return G_t+1 with discount γ
Training curriculum for λ scheduling

2512.23097.novelty: prior work (MiniLLM, On-Policy Distillation) 分别处理 KD 或 RL，本文严格证明轨迹级 KL+reward 梯度的精确分解，指出 Dense term 可零方差解析计算，而非近似；同时给出与 KL-regularized RLHF 的等价性证明（β=1/λ），并统一 SFT/KD/on-policy distillation/pure-RL 为特例。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: Algorithm 1, line 4: 'Generate K responses {y^(i)}_{i=1}^K from π_θ(·|x) // Group rollout'; line 7: 'c_t^(i) ← log π_θ(y_t^(i)|x,y_{<t}^(i)) − log π_ref(y_t^(i)|x,y_{<t}^(i))'; line 14: 'Dense: g_dense ← p⊙(log p − log q − D_KL(p∥q)·1)' — teacher logits q are queried per training step against student rollouts.

opd_classification.reasoning: 学生在训练循环内 on-policy 采样，teacher 提供 logit 级软标签作为 Dense 信号，同时有 reward 信号作为 Sparse 信号，属于 on-policy distillation + reward 的混合框架；与 external teacher model 对应 §5.1/§5.2。

key_findings: 轨迹级 KL+reward 梯度精确分解为 Dense（解析、零方差）和 Sparse（蒙特卡洛）两项，Dense term 等价于 token 级 KL 梯度（Theorem 1, Proposition 4）。
Top-K（K=32）近似实现可将梯度存储与计算量相对 full vocabulary（|V|≈128,000）减少约 4000×（Appendix B.3）。
本框架与 KL-regularized RLHF 数学等价（β=1/λ），并通过 γ 和 λ 的不同取值统一了 SFT/KD、on-policy distillation、pure RL 等现有方法。
2512.23097.ablations_summary: 本文为理论/框架论文，无实验 ablation；通过 γ∈{0,1} 和 λ 取值的特例分析展示各方法的统一关系（Section 5.5）。
limitations: 作者明确声明未进行实验验证，future work 包括 empirical validation（Section 6 结尾）。
方差-偏差权衡（不同 γ 值）的分析留待未来工作。

theory.theoretical_claim: Gradient of trajectory-level KL+reward decomposes into Dense (analytic token-level KL gradient, zero variance) + Sparse (REINFORCE future return) terms; mathematical equivalence to KL-regularized RLHF (β=1/λ); references DAgger O(µ|S|H/N) interactive imitation learning bound from prior work [4]
theory.proof_sketch: 利用 Score Function Vanishing Lemma 和 Causality Lemma，通过 REINFORCE identity 分解梯度；Dense term 的解析性通过词表求和的闭合形式证明（Appendix A.1-A.5）。

2512.23097.relevance_to_opd: 本文是 OPD 的核心理论基础之一：严格推导了 on-policy student rollout + external teacher logit 信号的混合梯度公式，证明 Dense（imitation）与 Sparse（RL reward）可同时优化，直接支撑 §5.1/§5.2 类 OPD 方法的理论合法性。

2601.02780.title: MiMo-V2-Flash Technical Report
2601.02780.authors_first: LLM-Core Xiaomi (no individual first author listed)
2601.02780.summary: MiMo-V2-Flash是小米发布的309B总参数、15B激活参数的MoE模型，提出Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation（MOPD）后训练范式，通过学生模型在线采样+多个域专用教师的token级KL奖励实现多能力整合，同时结合混合SWA架构和MTP推测解码加速，在SWE-Bench Verified达73.4%，推理最高2.6×加速。

method.training_loop: Stage1: SFT on diverse instruction data; Stage2: 独立RL/SFT训练多个domain-specialized teacher models（数学/代码/搜索/工具/安全）; Stage3 MOPD: student policy π_θ 从自身分布采样轨迹 y~μ_θ(·|x)，对每个token t计算 Â_MOPD,t = sg[log(π_domain_x(y_t|x,y<t)/π_θ(y_t|x,y<t))]作为KL advantage，可与ORM advantage（GRPO）加权组合，最终更新θ；使用training-inference importance sampling截断大离差token；RL引擎用Megatron-LM训练、SGLang推理
method.loss_formulation: L_{MOPD}(θ) = -E_{x~D, y~μ_θ(·|x)} [ (1/|y|) Σ_t w_t * Â_{MOPD,t} * log π_θ(y_t|x,y_{<t}) ]，其中 Â_{MOPD,t} = sg[log(π_{domain_x}(y_t|x,y_{<t}) / π_θ(y_t|x,y_{<t}))] + α*Â_{ORM}，w_t 为 importance sampling 截断权重（超出[ε_low, ε_high]时置0）
method.data_source: SFT：内部域专用模型生成的多领域instruction-response对（含thinking/non-thinking模式）；RL：GitHub issues（~90K+30K code tasks）、Stack Overflow/Exchange（~30K terminal tasks）、合成web页面（web dev tasks）、合成search tasks（150K）、合成function-calling tasks（50K）
key_components: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD)
Hybrid Sliding Window Attention (SWA, W=128, 5:1 local:global ratio)
Lightweight Multi-Token Prediction (MTP, 3-layer, 0.33B/layer)
Learnable attention sink bias
Rollout Routing Replay (R3) for MoE routing consistency
GRPO-style ORM advantage combined with MOPD KL advantage
Token-level reverse KL divergence from domain-specialized teachers
Domain-specialized teacher models via independent RL (math, code, search, tool-use, safety)

2601.02780.novelty: 与prior work的核心差异：(1) 提出MOPD，将多教师知识整合形式化为on-policy RL，学生每步从自身分布采样，再用各domain teacher的token级log-ratio作为优势函数，而非参数融合(model merging)或离线蒸馏静态数据集；(2) 在同一RL目标内同时结合KL-teacher信号和ORM(GRPO)奖励；(3) 混合SWA(W=128)+attention sink bias架构在长上下文性能超越全局注意力baseline；(4) MTP预训练单头、后训练复制为K头用于投机解码，兼顾RL rollout加速和推理加速。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: Rather than merging model parameters or generating static offline datasets from experts, we formulate multi-teacher knowledge integration as an on-policy reinforcement learning process. The student model samples from its own evolving distribution and receives token-level supervision from domain-specific teachers through KL divergence rewards, effectively combining specialized capabilities without the traditional trade-offs... By learning from its own distribution, the student avoids the exposure bias and distribution mismatch common in off-policy methods trained on static datasets.

opd_classification.reasoning: MOPD是典型的on-policy distillation：学生在训练循环内实时采样轨迹，teacher信号来自外部domain-specialized教师模型（通过token级KL divergence），同时结合ORM/verifier奖励（§5.3.3特征）；主体上teacher是独立训练的外部模型，对应§5.2（cross-model on-policy KD）

student.name: Qwen3-32B (RL training subject in Appendix B)

stabilization_tricks: Rollout Routing Replay (R3) for MoE expert routing consistency between rollout and training
FP8 mixed precision for both training and inference
num-zeros stability metric monitoring for MoE SFT
Training-inference importance sampling with token-level clipping (w_t=0 for out-of-range ratios)
Partial rollout with staleness-aware truncated importance sampling
Data Scheduler with priority-based scheduling and pass-rate filtering

train: Internal SFT dataset (millions of samples, diverse domains including reasoning/coding/agent/safety)
Synthetic web development tasks (8 categories, Playwright-verified)
Synthetic search tasks (150K, recursive fact-graph expansion)

key_findings: MOPD使学生在AIME 2025达94.1%，超过最佳RL教师（93.9%）+0.2%，在LiveCodeBench达83.2%超越最佳RL教师82.6%+0.6%，验证了on-policy多教师蒸馏可保留甚至超越各域最强教师性能。
MiMo-V2-Flash在SWE-Bench Verified达73.4%，SWE-Bench Multilingual达71.7%，成为最强开源代码代理LLM，仅用DeepSeek-V3.2总参数的1/2、Kimi-K2的1/3。
3层MTP模块在不同batch size下实现最高2.6×解码加速，NTP熵与接受长度呈强反相关（R²=0.995，最高accept length 3.6 tokens in WebDev）。
2601.02780.ablations_summary: 图6对比ORM-only、MOPD w/o ORM、MOPD+ORM三种方法：在AIME 2025上MOPD+ORM最终达~94%，MOPD w/o ORM~93%，ORM-only~92%；在LiveCodeBench上趋势类似，MOPD保留并超越最强教师。表2-4验证W=128+attention sink的SWA比W=512更优，且在通用/长上下文/推理三类benchmark上均超过全局注意力baseline。
limitations: 与最强闭源模型（如Gemini 3.0 Pro, GPT-5-High）仍有明显差距，作者计划通过扩大模型规模和训练计算来缩小差距。
当前架构探索仍属初步，对设计trade-off的分析有限，未来将聚焦更鲁棒高效的面向agentic的模型架构。
MOPD中teacher-student co-evolution的计算规模尚未充分扩展，潜力未完全释放。
failure_modes: BrowseComp评分中MOPD后学生（45.4）低于最佳SFT教师（51.7），Δ=-6.3%，表明搜索代理域的蒸馏存在性能损失。
Arena-Hard Creative Writing中MOPD后学生（86.2）低于最佳Self教师（90.1），Δ=-3.9%。
GPQA-Diamond中MOPD后学生（84.3）略低于最佳Self教师（84.9），Δ=-0.6%。
Appendix B记录在未清理SWE-Bench官方镜像中RL训练时Qwen3-32B出现reward hacking（通过偷看未来commit获取奖励），需要专门修复。

theory.theoretical_claim: null

2601.02780.relevance_to_opd: MiMo-V2-Flash的MOPD是OPD的多教师扩展实例：学生在训练循环内实时从自身分布采样（on-policy），每个domain对应一个专用外部teacher提供token级reverse-KL advantage，与ORM reward联合优化；这是§5.2 external-teacher on-policy KD的工业级大规模实践，并额外支持teacher即student自身（§5.3.2 self-distillation兼容），通过teacher-student co-evolution形成闭环迭代提升。

2511.10643.title: Black-Box On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models
2511.10643.summary: 提出GAD（Generative Adversarial Distillation），通过生成对抗框架实现黑盒on-policy蒸馏：学生（生成器）产生响应，判别器区分学生/教师输出，判别器分数作为on-policy奖励反馈，二者在minimax博弈中共同演化，无需访问教师logits即可超越标准SeqKD基线。

method.training_loop: 1) Warmup: 学生用教师响应做SFT（CE Loss），判别器用BT Loss训练1 epoch；2) GAD阶段: 每轮对prompt采样N=8条学生响应，判别器对(teacher, student)对计算BT Loss更新，学生用GRPO以D(G(x))为reward更新；两者交替迭代至收敛。
method.loss_formulation: V(G,D) = E_{(x,y_t)~T}[-log\sigma(D(y_t) - D(G(x)))]; Generator: \max_G E[D(G(x))]; Discriminator: \min_D E[-\log\sigma(D(y_t) - D(G(x)))]
method.data_source: LMSYS-Chat-1M-Clean（200K样本），教师响应由GPT-5-Chat API生成
key_components: Bradley-Terry pairwise discriminator
On-policy reward from co-evolving discriminator
GRPO policy gradient for generator
SFT + discriminator warmup stage

2511.10643.novelty: 首次将GAN框架引入黑盒LLM蒸馏：判别器作为on-policy reward model与学生共同演化，解决了黑盒设置下无logits监督时无法做on-policy学习的问题；与SeqKD（纯SFT）相比避免了局部n-gram过拟合；与固定reward model的RLHF相比，判别器持续更新避免reward hacking。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: GAD jointly trains the student and discriminator for one warmup epoch followed by two GAD training epochs, positioning the discriminator as an on-policy reward model. We observe that the student trained with an off-policy discriminator quickly exhibits reward hacking after around 300 training steps, producing excessively long responses (up to 1300 tokens) that deviate significantly from the teacher's patterns. In comparison, GAD remains stable through thousands of training steps with no sign of reward hacking.

opd_classification.reasoning: 学生在训练循环内实时rollout，判别器（由外部教师响应训练）提供on-policy reward信号，属于外部教师模型驱动的on-policy黑盒蒸馏（§5.2 cross-tokenizer/black-box外部teacher scenario）。

training_setup.compute_budget: 16×H100 × ~30h（Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct from GPT-5-Chat takes ~30 hours on 16 H100 GPUs）
stabilization_tricks: On-policy co-evolving discriminator to prevent reward hacking

key_findings: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct经GAD蒸馏后LMSYS-Chat GPT-4o得分52.1，超过GPT-5-Chat教师的51.7，SeqKD仅50.6。
Qwen2.5-3B经GAD蒸馏后性能匹配Qwen2.5-7B+SeqKD，实现跨一个规模级别的模型压缩效果。
off-policy判别器在约300步后发生reward hacking（响应长度飙升至1300 tokens），on-policy判别器全程稳定无reward hacking。
2511.10643.ablations_summary: 生成器warmup缺失→LMSYS分从50.8降至49.7；判别器warmup缺失→49.0；BT Loss换CE Loss→48.9→47.9；判别器放大（3B→7B或7B→14B）不提升甚至略降性能，等大generator-discriminator对最优。
limitations: 训练需同时维护生成器和判别器两个模型，计算/显存开销约为SeqKD的2倍。
判别器模型大小需与生成器匹配，增大判别器无益，限制了用更强判别器提升效果的可能性。
failure_modes: Off-policy判别器约300步后reward hacking：学生生成过长响应（up to 1300 tokens）偏离教师模式。

theory.theoretical_claim: null

2511.10643.relevance_to_opd: GAD是on-policy black-box蒸馏的核心实例：学生在训练循环内实时采样rollout，用外部教师响应训练的co-evolving判别器作为on-policy reward signal，完全符合OPD定义；且解决了跨tokenizer场景下无法用白盒KL loss的问题，是§5.2（外部教师+on-policy+黑盒）的典型方法。

2512.05105.title: Semantic Soft Bootstrapping: Long Context Reasoning in LLMs without Reinforcement Learning
2512.05105.summary: 提出 Semantic Soft Bootstrapping（SSB），一种无 RL 的自蒸馏方法：同一基础模型同时扮演教师（接收含正确/错误 rollout 的提示）和学生（仅接收裸问题），离线预计算教师 logits 后通过 KL 散度蒸馏，在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上仅用 256 样本即超越 GRPO 10.6%（MATH500）和 10%（AIME2024）。

method.training_loop: Phase1(离线): 对每道题用基础模型采样K次rollout → 筛选正确和最常见错误各一条 → 构造hinted提示让模型生成精炼解 → 预计算并保存教师logits到磁盘。Phase2(训练): 学生仅看裸问题+精炼答案 → LoRA微调最小化学生logits与冻结教师logits的KL散度 → 无在线采样，无reward信号。
method.loss_formulation: \mathcal{L} = \frac{1}{|T|} \sum_i \frac{T_{KD}^2}{|\tilde{r}|} \sum_j \mathrm{KL}\!\left(\mathrm{softmax}\!\left(\frac{\ell_i^j}{T_{KD}}\right) \Big\|\, \mathrm{softmax}\!\left(\frac{\hat{\ell}_i^j}{T_{KD}}\right)\right)
method.data_source: GSM8K（仅使用问题和最终答案，不使用任何人工标注的解题步骤）
key_components: 自蒸馏语义上下文对比（hinted teacher vs. hint-free student）
离线rollout采样与教师logits预计算
温度缩放KL散度蒸馏损失（仅对答案token）
LoRA参数高效微调（rank=32）
正确+最常见错误rollout过滤构造教学对

2512.05105.novelty: SSB 与 GRPO/RLVR 的区别在于：(1)完全无 RL，无 reward 信号，无在线采样；(2)同一模型在不同语义上下文下充当教师和学生，而非依赖更大外部教师；(3)通过存储教师 logits 实现离线蒸馏，训练阶段无须教师推理开销；(4)256 样本远少于 GRPO 的 2000 样本即取得更优性能；(5)回应长度不随训练增加，挑战了「更长 CoT = 更强推理」的普遍假设。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: We keep the process strictly RL-free (no on-policy sampling during training and no reward optimization), and we use the teacher to synthesize a single corrected explanation from correct and incorrect traces, which is then distilled via stored teacher logits into a student that only ever sees the raw, hint-free questions. To avoid recomputing teacher logits during training, we precompute and store the logits over the answer sequence, enabling efficient offline distillation without any human annotation or online RL loop.

opd_classification.reasoning: SSB uses in-context learning bootstrapping as curriculum design for self-distillation. Primary contribution is the curriculum/bootstrapping mechanism, not the external feedback signal. Correctly placed in §6.2 (Curriculum and Difficulty Adaptation) in the survey.

stabilization_tricks: 仅蒸馏答案token的logits而非全序列

train: GSM8K（仅问题+最终答案，950题中筛选256个有效对）

key_findings: SSB 在 MATH500 上以 256 个训练样本达到 55.4% 准确率，比同等设置下 GRPO（2000 样本）高 10.6%，比基础模型高 17.8%。
SSB 在 AIME2024 上从 0% 提升至 13.33%，比 GRPO 高 10%，表明仅靠 logit 蒸馏即可泛化到 distribution-shift 困难题。
SSB 训练过程中回应长度不增加，挑战了「更长 CoT 是推理提升必要条件」的假设，损失单调下降且梯度范数收敛。
2512.05105.ablations_summary: 论文未提供系统消融实验。仅进行了三方对比（基础模型 vs GRPO vs SSB），未消融 rollout 数量 K、蒸馏温度 T_KD、LoRA rank 或损失公式各分项的贡献。
limitations: 仅在单一模型（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct）和单一训练集（GSM8K）上验证，未测试更大模型或其他领域。
GRPO 基线使用 2000 样本而 SSB 仅用 256 样本，计算量对比不完全公平。
未报告蒸馏温度 T_KD 的确切值。
未研究 SSB 的样本效率和 scaling law，未与现代 RLVR 流水线进行系统性计算-精度权衡比较。
未测试代码合成、科学问答等其他领域的泛化能力。
failure_modes: 当所有 K 次 rollout 均正确或均错误时，该问题被丢弃（无法构造教学对），导致有效数据量从 950 题缩减至 256 题（约 27% 利用率）。

theory.theoretical_claim: null

2512.05105.relevance_to_opd: SSB 是离线自蒸馏（offline self-distillation），非 on-policy distillation（OPD）。其 rollout 在训练前一次性生成并保存，训练阶段无在线采样，无 reward/verifier 信号，与 OPD 的核心特征（训练循环内实时学生 rollout + 动态 teacher/verifier 信号）完全不符。作为对比 baseline，SSB 体现了离线 logit 蒸馏路线的上限，可用于量化 on-policy 机制带来的增益。

2510.23497.title: VOLD: Reasoning Transfer from LLMs to Vision-Language Models via On-Policy Distillation
2510.23497.affiliation_primary: Tuebingen AI Center / University of Tuebingen
2510.23497.summary: VOLD 是一个两阶段框架，通过将 GRPO 强化学习与在线蒸馏相结合，将纯文本 LLM 的推理能力迁移到视觉语言模型（VLM），无需任何视觉推理数据。第一阶段用教师生成的 traces 做 SFT 对齐，第二阶段用统一目标同步执行 GRPO 和 on-policy KL 蒸馏，并通过 reward-guided KL masking 防止干扰。

method.training_loop: Stage1: 用 Qwen3-8B 教师在 MoT 数据集生成 traces，对 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 学生做 SFT（4000 steps，冻结视觉编码器）。Stage2: 对每个文本 prompt 从学生策略采样 K=5 条 rollout，同时计算 GRPO 奖励（exact match binary reward）和教师对相同 prefix 的 logits；合并为统一损失 L_VOLD = L_GRPO + β·E[(1-r(τ))·KL(π_φ||π_θ)]，仅对失败 rollout 启用 KL 蒸馏（reward-guided masking）。
method.loss_formulation: L_{\text{VOLD-masked}}(\theta) = L_{\text{GRPO}}(\theta) + \beta \cdot \mathbb{E}_{q,\tau\sim\pi_\theta}\left[(1-r(\tau))\sum_{t=1}^{T} D_{\text{KL}}(\pi_\phi(\cdot|h_t) \| \pi_\theta(\cdot|h_t))\right]
method.data_source: SFT: Mixture-of-Thoughts (MoT) 350k 样本，由 Qwen3-8B 重新生成 traces 得到 'MoT-Teacher-8B'；RL: orz-57k 文本数学数据集（含 GT 答案）
key_components: Stage 1 SFT policy alignment（冻结视觉编码器）
Stage 2 GRPO + on-policy KL distillation 统一目标
Reward-guided KL masking（仅对失败 rollout 蒸馏）
k2 estimator 近似全词表 KL 散度
Asymmetric GRPO clipping (ε_upper=0.3, ε_lower=0.2)

2510.23497.novelty: 首个将纯文本 LLM 作为教师通过 on-policy 蒸馏训练 VLM 学生的框架（text-to-vision reasoning transfer）；相比 KDRL（text-to-text）扩展到跨模态场景；相比 X-Reasoner（同样 text-only 训练）新增 on-policy 教师信号，而非仅 off-policy SFT traces；引入 reward-guided KL masking 防止 RL 探索与蒸馏的信号冲突；理论上证明 SFT 分布对齐是 on-policy 蒸馏有效性的必要前提。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: The key insight driving this approach is that both GRPO and on-policy knowledge distillation require sampling trajectories from the student policy πθ—the computationally expensive component of both training paradigms. By reusing the same rollouts for both objectives, we provide dense teacher guidance to the RL process with minimal computational overhead. [...] the teacher is queried on the same prefix h_t to provide distributional targets that adapt to the student's evolving policy.

opd_classification.reasoning: 使用外部固定教师模型（Qwen3-8B/4B/14B）对学生实时 rollout 的 prefix 提供 token-level KL 蒸馏信号，属于 external-teacher on-policy distillation（§5.2）；同时第一阶段 off-policy SFT 属于 §5.1。

key_findings: VOLD 在纯文本训练下于 MathVision 达到 28.0%，超过使用图像训练的 VLAA-Thinker（24.4%）和 VLM-R1-Math（21.9% base）
Stage 1 SFT 对齐是 on-policy 蒸馏有效的必要条件：使用与教师策略不匹配的 MoT 原始 traces（DeepSeek-R1 生成）做 SFT 时，蒸馏阶段无任何增益
Reward-guided KL masking 将最终训练奖励从 0.56（无 masking）提升至 0.58，且整个训练过程持续领先
2510.23497.ablations_summary: （1）Policy alignment ablation：使用原始 MoT（DeepSeek-R1 traces）替换 MoT-Teacher-8B 做 SFT 后，SFT+RL+Distillation 与 SFT+RL 性能几乎相同，证明分布对齐是 on-policy 蒸馏的前提。（2）Component analysis：SFT-only → SFT+RL → SFT+RL+Distillation 逐步提升，MMStar 从 49.7→50.5→55.2，MathVision 从 18.6→24.0→28.0。（3）SFT step ablation：SFT steps < 1000 时 on-policy 蒸馏无收益；~3000 steps 后性能趋于饱和。（4）Teacher size ablation：4B→8B 有提升，8B→14B 收益递减（学生容量瓶颈）。（5）KL masking ablation：masked VOLD (0.58) > unmasked VOLD (0.56) > GRPO (0.51)。
limitations: SFT 阶段使用未过滤的教师 traces（含错误推理路径），导致 SFT-only 模型相比 base model 性能下降；过滤会大幅增加计算成本
教师与学生必须共享 tokenizer 和词表，限制了跨 tokenizer 蒸馏的适用性
学生模型（3B）存在容量瓶颈，14B 教师相比 8B 教师无显著提升
RL 阶段仅训练 60 steps，实验规模相对有限
failure_modes: 无分布对齐时 on-policy 蒸馏完全失效（与 SFT+RL baseline 无差异）
SFT 步数过少（<1000 steps）时，蒸馏信号对 RL 无正向贡献，早期 checkpoint 甚至弱于 base model

theory.theoretical_claim: 当学生策略 π_θ 与教师策略 π_φ 分布差距过大时，reverse KL 梯度在 off-distribution prefixes 处弥散或高方差，导致 on-policy 蒸馏失效；SFT 对齐通过提升 π_φ 在学生 rollout 前缀处的概率质量来降低梯度方差，改善优化条件（formal motivation for alignment necessity）
theory.proof_sketch: minimizing E_{h_t ~ π_θ}[D_KL(π_φ || π_θ)] 在 π_φ 低熵（高置信度）区域处于高效；SFT 使 π_θ 的 rollout 分布更接近 π_φ 的支撑集，从而确保 KL 信号有信息量且梯度稳定

2510.23497.relevance_to_opd: VOLD 是 OPD 的直接实例：学生 VLM 在每个训练迭代中生成 rollout，固定外部教师 LLM 对相同 prefix 实时提供 token-level KL 目标（reverse KL），与 GRPO 奖励信号联合优化。属于 external-teacher on-policy distillation，且有跨模态（text teacher → VLM student）的独特设定。Reward-guided masking 是防止 RL 探索与蒸馏干扰的关键机制，对 OPD 框架设计有参考价值。

2510.18874.title: Retaining by Doing: The Role of On-Policy Data in Mitigating Forgetting
2510.18874.summary: 系统比较SFT与RL后训练中灾难性遗忘的差异。跨Llama/Qwen多模型和3个任务发现，RL（GRPO）比SFT遗忘显著更少，且目标任务性能相当或更高。核心结论：在线策略数据生成（而非KL正则化或优势估计）是RL抗遗忘的主要机制。提出Iterative-SFT作为高效替代方案。

method.loss_formulation: J_{RL}(\theta;x) := \mathbb{E}_{y\sim\pi_\theta(\cdot|x)}[r(x,y)] - \beta \cdot \mathrm{KL}[\pi_\theta(\cdot|x) \| \pi_{\theta_0}(\cdot|x)]; \quad L_{SFT}(\theta;x) := -\sum_y \pi_*(y|x)\log\pi_\theta(y|x) = \mathrm{KL}[\pi_*(\cdot|x)\|\pi_\theta(\cdot|x)] + H(\pi_*(\cdot|x))
method.data_source: IFEval 13k (from Tulu3), MMLU 12k, Countdown 10k (arithmetic reasoning); SFT labels generated by Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct; RL reward: binary verifier r(x,y)∈{0,1}
key_components: GRPO (on-policy RL, group size G=5, KL β=0.05)
SFT (off-policy, forward KL, teacher-generated data)
Iterative-SFT (approximately on-policy: data regenerated per epoch)
Self-SFT (once-before-training on correct self-generated responses)
REINFORCE ablation (no advantage estimator)
Mixture-of-Gaussians theoretical model (reverse KL vs forward KL multi-modal analysis)

2510.18874.novelty: 首个受控系统比较研究，隔离证明了在线策略数据（而非KL正则化或优势估计）是RL抗遗忘的主因；通过REINFORCE消融排除优势估计贡献，通过β=0 vs β=0.05消融排除KL正则化贡献；提出Iterative-SFT（每epoch重生成数据）作为计算高效替代方案，接近RL的遗忘抑制效果。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: In RL, the goal is to maximize the KL-regularized reward with respect to responses generated by the LM and a reward function r(x,y) ∈ {0,1}, i.e.: J_RL(θ;x) := E_{y~π_θ(·|x)}[r(x,y)] − β·KL[π_θ(·|x)||π_θ0(·|x)], where β > 0 and π_θ0 is the initial policy. We implement RL using GRPO (Shao et al., 2024), which samples a group of G=5 responses per prompt and uses group-relative advantage estimates.

opd_classification.reasoning: 学生在训练循环内实时采样rollout，使用binary verifier reward（GT answer验证）作为信号源，属于verifier-RLVR类型；同时有Iterative-SFT变体使用PI(GT)过滤正确rollout，对应§5.3.1

benchmarks.name: Countdown (Llama-3.1-8B)
benchmarks.note: RL gain=47.7%, drop=0.9%; SFT gain=37.6%, drop=36.4%

benchmarks.name: Countdown (Llama-3.2-1B)
benchmarks.note: RL gain=60.4%, drop=-0.5%; SFT gain=25.3%, drop=24.2%

benchmarks.name: MMLU (Llama-3.1-8B)
benchmarks.note: RL gain=14.6%, drop=-0.2%; SFT gain=11.1%, drop=38.5%

benchmarks.name: IFEval (Qwen-2.5-7B)
benchmarks.note: RL gain=17.0%, drop=0.2%; SFT gain=18.0%, drop=30.0%

key_findings: RL（GRPO）在所有12个模型×任务组合中，遗忘量（drop）均远小于SFT：SFT drop最高达44%（MMLU+Llama-1B），RL drop最高仅3.4%。
KL正则化非主因：β=0.0与β=0.05的GRPO遗忘表现相近（Figure 6）；KL散度与遗忘的Pearson相关仅r=0.52。
Iterative-SFT（每epoch重生成数据）可以接近RL的遗忘抑制效果，同时计算成本远低于完整RL训练。
2510.18874.ablations_summary: 三项关键消融：(1) KL正则化消融（β=0 vs β=0.05）：遗忘差异微小，排除KL为主因；(2) 优势估计消融（GRPO vs REINFORCE）：REINFORCE遗忘量同样低，排除优势估计为主因；(3) 在线策略程度谱（SFT→Self-SFT→Iterative-SFT→SFT-on-RL-data→GRPO）：越接近在线策略遗忘越少，确认在线策略数据为核心机制。
limitations: 仅测试至8B参数模型，更大规模的遗忘规律未验证
理论分析局限于简化的Mixture-of-Gaussians模型，未提供严格的实际LM证明
仅测试binary verifiable reward（RLVR），未涵盖RLHF（学习奖励模型）场景
未研究数据集规模缩放对遗忘模式的影响
failure_modes: RL在目标分布与初始策略差异极大时仍会发生遗忘（Figure 8，距离4.0-6.0时理论模型显示RL也遗忘）
Self-SFT在某些场景（Countdown Qwen-2.5-7B）遗忘严重（drop=22.4%），单次生成数据不足以抑制遗忘

theory.theoretical_claim: Mixture-of-Gaussians bi-modal setting: reverse KL (RL) forgets less than forward KL (SFT) by preserving old mode mass; uni-modal setting: SFT forgets less
theory.proof_sketch: 定义双模态最优策略π*(y)=α*·p_old(y)+（1-α*）·p_new(y)；定义遗忘度量为旧模式覆盖度S_old下降；数值模拟显示双模态下reverse KL drop=0.03 vs forward KL drop=0.12（gain=0.90时）

2510.18874.relevance_to_opd: 本文是OPD的分析性研究：证明了在线策略数据生成是RL抗遗忘的核心机制，为OPD设计提供理论和实验依据。虽不提出新的KD方法，但直接回答了'为何on-policy训练优于off-policy'的核心问题，对OPD框架的设计有重要指导意义。

2510.11615.title: LLM-Oriented Token-Adaptive Knowledge Distillation
2510.11615.summary: AdaKD is a plug-and-play logit-based KD framework that dynamically adapts to each token's real-time learning state via two synergistic modules: LATF (Loss-driven Adaptive Token Focusing) adjusts token selection ratio via an EMA loss feedback loop, and IDTS (Inverse Difficulty Temperature Scaling) assigns low temperatures to hard tokens and high to easy ones using Hellinger distance as difficulty indicator, consistently improving multiple KD baselines across architectures.

method.training_loop: For each batch: (1) compute teacher/student logits on ground-truth sequences; (2) compute per-token Hellinger difficulty s_i; (3) update LATF ratio r_t via EMA loss feedback (increase ratio if loss rises beyond tolerance, decrease if loss drops); (4) compute per-token temperature τ_i = τ_base·exp(−c·ŝ_i) via IDTS; (5) select top-r% hardest tokens; (6) compute selective KL loss L_AdaKD; (7) update student θ via gradient descent. Warm-up: r=1.0 for first 5% steps.
method.loss_formulation: L_{distill} = \frac{1}{L \cdot r\%} \sum_{i=1}^{L} I_{r\%}(y_i) \cdot D_{KL}(q_\theta \| p), \text{ where } \tau_i = \tau_{base} \cdot \exp(-c \cdot \hat{s}_i), \; \hat{s}_i = \tanh(\log(s_i / \text{median}(s))), \; s_i = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\sqrt{\sum_{y_i \in V}(\sqrt{p(y_i)} - \sqrt{q_\theta(y_i)})^2}
method.data_source: databricks-dolly-15k (fixed ground-truth sequences; off-policy)
key_components: LATF (Loss-driven Adaptive Token Focusing): dynamic token selection ratio via EMA loss feedback loop
IDTS (Inverse Difficulty Temperature Scaling): per-token temperature inversely proportional to difficulty
Hellinger distance as unified token-level difficulty indicator
EMA loss tracking with tolerance zone and warm-up period

2510.11615.novelty: Prior selective KD methods (Selective KD, AdaDS) use fixed token ratios or RL-based selectors; prior temperature methods (AnnealingKD, CTKD) apply fixed or curriculum easy→hard schedules at sample level. AdaKD introduces: (1) dynamically adaptive token selection ratio driven by real-time loss feedback rather than fixed schedule; (2) counterintuitive inverse temperature assignment at token level—low temperature for hard tokens (sharp corrective signal), high temperature for easy tokens (rich distribution learning)—mathematically grounded via gradient norm analysis showing ‖∇D_KL^(τ_i)‖² ∝ s_i²/τ_i⁴.

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: Our work focuses on logit-based distillation, a prevalent white-box approach that directly transfers knowledge by matching the output distributions of the teacher and student models. AdaKD trains on fixed ground-truth sequences from databricks-dolly-15k, computing Hellinger difficulty from teacher/student logits on those sequences without any student rollouts.

opd_classification.reasoning: AdaKD is purely off-policy logit matching on fixed ground-truth data using an external teacher; no student rollouts in the training loop.

stabilization_tricks: EMA loss tracking (β=0.97) to smooth training signal
Tolerance zone (ε=0.05) to prevent ratio oscillation
detach() on difficulty scores to avoid backprop overhead

key_findings: AdaKD consistently improves all 5 KD baselines across all 3 model families; largest gain is GKD+AdaKD on GPT-2 (+2.12 avg ROUGE-L), exceeding the teacher's own score.
IDTS alone contributes +1.52 avg ROUGE-L; LATF alone contributes only +0.04; full AdaKD gives +1.98—LATF acts as a noise filter that unlocks IDTS effectiveness rather than contributing independently.

The inverted temperature direction is essential: applying conventional easy→hard temperature direction drops performance to 35.67 avg (below the RKD baseline of 37.03), confirming the counterintuitive design is critical.
2510.11615.ablations_summary: IDTS alone: +1.52 avg ROUGE-L over RKD baseline; LATF alone: +0.04; combined AdaKD: +1.98. Hellinger distance marginally outperforms CE (+0.16), JS-div (+0.30), NMTKD (+0.17). Adaptive LATF (+0.42) outperforms cosine schedule (+0.28) and fixed r=0.75 (−0.42). Inverse temperature direction is critical—wrong direction causes −1.36 degradation vs baseline.
limitations: LATF discrete ratio adjustment causes slight training oscillations
IDTS temperature formulation is heuristic and lacks formal theoretical grounding for the specific functional form
Evaluation limited to instruction-following tasks; extension to reasoning and code not validated
Marginal improvement on FKD (+0.07) due to conceptual conflict between FKD's mean-seeking objective and IDTS's targeted correction
failure_modes: AdaKD+FKD: nearly no improvement (+0.07 avg ROUGE-L) because FKD's mean-seeking KL direction conflicts with IDTS's hard-token correction strategy
Incorrect temperature direction (non-inverted) degrades performance below baseline: avg 35.67 vs RKD baseline 37.03

theory.theoretical_claim: Entropy monotonically increases with temperature (dH/dτ = Var_{p(τ)}(z)/τ³ ≥ 0); gradient norm ‖∇D_KL^(τ_i)‖² ∝ s_i²/τ_i⁴ formally justifies inverse difficulty temperature
theory.proof_sketch: Section 3.5 proves entropy monotonicity; Section 3.6 derives gradient norm proportionality to s_i²/τ_i⁴, showing lower temperature for harder tokens yields larger corrective gradient updates—no convergence bounds provided.

2510.11615.relevance_to_opd: AdaKD is off-policy logit-matching KD with no student rollouts; it is a baseline/contrast to OPD methods. Its LATF+IDTS framework could in principle be applied to on-policy settings but the paper does not explore this. Serves as a strong off-policy KD baseline for comparison.

2510.07842.title: AdaSwitch: Balancing Exploration and Guidance in Knowledge Distillation via Adaptive Switching
2510.07842.affiliation_primary: University of Science and Technology of China / CityU Hong Kong / Baidu Inc.
2510.07842.summary: AdaSwitch是一种token级混合知识蒸馏框架，通过自适应单次切换机制动态结合on-policy探索与off-policy教师引导：学生自主生成直到KL散度超过滑动窗口自适应阈值，随后由教师接管剩余序列，在DialogSum/GSM/GSM-Plus三项任务上持续超越纯on/off-policy及混合基线方法。

method.training_loop: 每条序列：学生自主生成token（探索阶段），计算student-teacher per-token KL散度；维护长度L的滑动窗口均值d̄；若当前d_i > K·d̄_{i-1}则一次性切换至教师生成剩余所有token（引导阶段）；对整条混合序列做梯度下降最小化D(M_t ∥ M_s)(y|x)。
method.loss_formulation: \mathcal{L} = D(M_t \| M_s)(y|x) = \frac{1}{L_y}\sum_{i=1}^{L_y} d_i(x,y), \quad d_i = D\!\left(M_t(\cdot|y_{<i},x)\|M_s(\cdot|y_{<i},x)\right)
method.data_source: DialogSum（12.5K对话摘要）和GSM8K（8.5K数学推理），各随机采样约1K条用于KD训练；教师模型先在全训练集上SFT
key_components: adaptive sliding-window divergence threshold (τ = K·d̄)
one-time switching mechanism (student→teacher, no return)
per-token KL divergence monitoring
sliding window of length L for context-aware threshold

2510.07842.novelty: 相比SKD（投机解码+频繁双向切换）和SWITCH（固定衰减阈值+双向切换），AdaSwitch提出：(1)单次不可逆切换——切换后教师独占剩余序列，避免'chimera'碎片化；(2)自适应阈值——基于滑动窗口均值动态调整，适应不同样本难度；(3)无需speculative decoding额外开销，overhead仅1.2–1.4×。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: AdaSwitch adopts an adaptive one-time switching mechanism: the student initially generates tokens autonomously (Exploration Stage) to maintain training-inference consistency. Once the student's divergence from the teacher exceeds a dynamic threshold derived from recent generation history, the teacher takes over to generate the remaining sequence (Guidance Stage), ensuring high-quality outputs.

opd_classification.reasoning: 学生在训练循环内实时自主采样token（on-policy rollout），以外部教师logits为信号计算KL散度并监督学习，属于外部教师模型引导的on-policy蒸馏（§5.2混合on/off-policy变体）。

key_findings: AdaSwitch在GSM任务上超越第二优方法7.2%（Llama）和11.8%（Qwen），在所有三个任务和三个模型族上持续最优。
AdaSwitch运行开销仅为on-policy的1.2–1.4×，比SKD/SWITCH低约10%，实现性能与效率的优良权衡。
单次切换设计（最多切换1次）明显优于允许多次切换的变体：允许2次时GSM准确率从35.0降至34.8，Rouge-L从35.6降至35.2，且训练不稳定性显著增加。
2510.07842.ablations_summary: （1）最大切换次数1→3：性能单调下降且误差棒扩大，验证one-time switching设计；（2）K参数3–4时最优，过大增探索过多、过小增引导；（3）L=10附近最优，过大降灵敏度、过小过于敏感；（4）KL、JSD、ReverseKLD三种散度度量下AdaSwitch均稳定最优，显示鲁棒性。
limitations: 实验仅覆盖三个任务（摘要/GSM/GSM-Plus）和三个LLM家族，未验证更广泛领域的泛化性。
KD训练阶段计算开销较纯on-policy约高30%（虽推理阶段无额外开销）。
failure_modes: 频繁双向切换会生成语义不连贯的'chimera'序列，Section 3.9实验中3次切换预算下训练不稳定性显著增大。
on-policy方法在GSM等推理任务早期阶段（step 30）准确率接近0%，凸显初始低质量输出的问题（AdaSwitch通过切换缓解）。

theory.theoretical_claim: null

2510.07842.relevance_to_opd: AdaSwitch是一个典型的on-policy蒸馏方法：学生在每次训练迭代中实时生成token（on-policy rollout），以外部教师logits的KL散度作为监督信号。其核心创新——自适应单次切换——是OPD框架内的序列生成策略改进，解决on-policy低质量输出与off-policy分布不匹配的矛盾，直接相关于OPD的核心问题（exposure bias vs. quality trade-off）。

2509.25837.title: Distillation of Large Language Models via Concrete Score Matching
2509.25837.affiliation_primary: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)
2509.25837.summary: 提出 Concrete Score Distillation（CSD），将离散具体分数匹配目标应用于自回归 LLM 知识蒸馏。CSD 同时解决 softmax 平滑导致的信息损失和直接 logit 蒸馏（DLD）的最优解集限制问题，通过匹配所有词汇对之间的相对 logit 差异，在线性时间内实现高效梯度计算，并在指令跟随、任务特定和通用对话蒸馏中一致超越现有方法。

method.training_loop: 对每个训练样本 (c,y)，计算学生 logit f_θ 和（不带梯度的）教师 logit f_T；选择权重函数 w=(w1,w2)（默认为 detached student 概率）；计算加权归一化 logit f̃；按 Algorithm 1 在 O(|V|) 时间内计算 CSD 梯度；用梯度更新学生参数 θ。支持 on-policy（ImitKD/GKD/DistiLLM）和 off-policy 数据集。
method.loss_formulation: L_{CSD}(\theta; p_T, w) := \frac{1}{2} \sum_{y_t \in V} \sum_{x \in V} w(y_t, x) \left( \log \frac{q_\theta(x|c,y_{<t})}{q_\theta(y_t|c,y_{<t})} - \log \frac{p_T(x|c,y_{<t})}{p_T(y_t|c,y_{<t})} \right)^2 = \frac{1}{2} \sum_{y_t} \sum_{x} w(y_t,x)(f_\theta[x]-f_\theta[y_t]-f_T[x]+f_T[y_t])^2
method.data_source: databricks-dolly-15k（指令跟随）；DialogSum / Flores-200 / GSM8K（任务特定）；UltraChat 50K 子集（通用对话）
key_components: Concrete Score Matching 离散分数匹配目标
对数变换消除训练不稳定性
O(|V|) 解析梯度计算（Theorem 3）
可分解双权重函数 w(y_t, x) = w1(y_t) · w2(x)
最优解集超集保证（CSD ⊋ DLD，Theorem 2）
Mode-seeking (S,S) 和 mode-covering (U,S)/(T,S) 多实例

2509.25837.novelty: 与 DLD（直接 MSE logit 匹配）相比，CSD 匹配所有词汇对之间的相对 logit 差异而非绝对值，从而对 logit 常数平移不变（logit shift invariance），最优解集严格包含 DLD 的最优解集。与 f-散度类方法（KL/RKL/SKL 等）相比，CSD 直接在 logit 层面操作，无 softmax 平滑信息损失。此外，双权重函数设计空间统一了 mode-seeking 和 mode-covering 行为，并理论证明对任意正权重函数 w 均保证一致性收敛至教师分布。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: We follow the training setup of DistiLLM (Ko et al., 2024). For the distillation dataset D, we use databricks-dolly-15k... The primary distinction among these methods, apart from their losses, lies in the choice of dataset D: ImitKD uses purely student-generated on-policy data, GKD combines fixed data with student outputs, and DistiLLM adaptively selects between them based on validation loss. As a result, the average ROUGE-L score improved for both GPT-2-0.1B and GPT-2-0.3B students in all settings... particularly strong performance under pure on-policy settings.

opd_classification.reasoning: 学生在训练循环内实时采样生成轨迹（ImitKD/GKD 模式），教师提供 logit 信号作为蒸馏目标，属于外部教师模型驱动的 on-policy distillation（§5.1）。

training_setup.compute_budget: 4× RTX 3090 GPUs（GPT-2/OpenLLaMA 实验）；单 A100 GPU（效率测量）
stabilization_tricks: 对数变换 concrete score 避免 likelihood ratio 发散
detached student probability 权重函数
O(|V|) 解析梯度计算避免 O(|V|²) 内存

key_findings: CSD 在 GPT-2-0.1B 纯损失对比实验中平均 ROUGE-L 达 20.65，超过所有 9 个对比方法（含 KL=16.68、SRKL=20.00、AB=19.78），且与 on-policy 方法结合可进一步提升至 20.73。
在任务特定蒸馏（Gemma-7B-IT→Gemma-2B-IT）中，CSD(T,S) 在摘要（35.67）、翻译（74.14）、GSM8K（25.78）三项任务上全面超越所有 DLD 变体，DLD(S) 在这些任务上准确率均为 0.00。
CSD 提供可控的多样性-保真度权衡：(S,S) 实现最高保真度，(U,S)/(T,S) 逐步增加多样性，且 CSD 的 Pareto 前沿包络了所有已有损失的权衡曲线，理论证明最优解集严格超集于 DLD（Θ*_CSD ⊋ Θ*_DLD）。
2509.25837.ablations_summary: Table 5 系统对比 CSD 双权重函数 (T/U/S, T/U/S) 组合与各 DLD 变体：(S,S) 最优（avg 20.65），其余 CSD 变体仍优于或接近对应 DLD；DLD-min/max/std/range 均不如朴素 DLD；Remark 4 证明 w1=w2 时 CSD 梯度等价于加权均值中心化的 DLD-mean。Monte Carlo 估计 vs 解析梯度：后者收敛略快但前者支持联合权重函数扩展（Figure 5c）。
limitations: CSD 直接损失值无法计算（仅梯度可用），导致任务特定实验中无法用验证损失选择检查点，只能使用最终 epoch。
双权重函数 (w1, w2) 的最优选择依赖任务和数据分布，作者留给未来工作进一步探索。
实验模型规模最大为 9B 参数，更大规模的可扩展性尚未验证。
failure_modes: 任务特定蒸馏中，CSD(S,S) 在小数据量场景下因 mode-seeking 行为导致 GSM8K 准确率为 0（Tables 11–15 中模型生成过长思维链但无法得出正确答案）。
DLD 全系列变体在 Gemma 任务特定蒸馏中准确率均崩溃至 0（Table 10），而 CSD(T,S) 可稳定蒸馏。

compute_efficiency.memory_footprint: CSD(Anal.) 内存低于 DLD 和 SKL（Table 9，如 GPT-2 1.5B→0.1B：CSD 28,920 MB vs DLD 30,490 MB vs SKL 39,130 MB），训练速度相当

theory.theoretical_claim: Proposition 1（一致性：任意正权重 w 下最优解恢复教师分布）；Theorem 2（解集超集：Θ*_CSD ⊋ Θ*_DLD）；Theorem 3（高效梯度：O(|V|²) 目标的梯度可在 O(|V|) 内解析计算）
theory.proof_sketch: Proposition 1 通过证明最优条件 f_θ[x]-f_θ[y_t]=f_T[x]-f_T[y_t] 等价于 softmax 后概率相等得证；Theorem 2 通过说明 DLD 最优条件（f_θ=f_T）是 CSD 最优条件（f_θ=f_T+C）在 C=0 的特例得证；Theorem 3 通过 w 可分解性因式分解双重求和化简为单重求和得证。

2509.25837.relevance_to_opd: CSD 是一种新型 logit-level 蒸馏损失，与 on-policy 数据生成（ImitKD/GKD/DistiLLM）正交且互补。论文 Table 2 明确展示与 on-policy 技术结合后的性能增益，学生实时采样轨迹用于训练（ImitKD 纯 on-policy），教师提供 logit 作为监督信号。CSD 可直接替换现有 OPD 框架中的损失函数，属于 external-teacher logit signal 驱动的 on-policy distillation 方法。

2509.22921.title: Rethinking Large Language Model Distillation: A Constrained Markov Decision Process Perspective
2509.22921.summary: 将LLM蒸馏建模为约束RL问题：最大化任务奖励同时约束student-teacher KL散度低于预设阈值d。通过改造Saute状态增广方法（去掉状态增广步骤）实现无需teacher访问的部署，同时保留约束满足理论保证，在数学推理任务上兼顾推理质量与约束满足率。

method.training_loop: 1. 用student policy采样rollout（每step生成token）；2. 计算trajectory-level约束奖励Rˆ_n：若累积KL ≤ d则给task reward R，否则给惩罚-(n+ϕ_π(s_T))；3. 用GRPO框架计算策略梯度：似然比项(I) + 显式依赖项(II)（infeasible区域贡献-∂_θ ϕ_π）；4. AdamW更新student参数；5. 重复20个epoch。
method.loss_formulation: J_n(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{\pi_\theta}\left[\sum_{t=0}^{\infty} \gamma^t \hat{R}_{\pi_\theta,n}(s_t, a_t)\right], \quad \hat{R}_{\pi,n}(s_T, a_T) = \begin{cases} R(s_T, a_T) & \text{if } d - \sum_{t=0}^{T-1} C_\pi(s_t) \geq 0 \\ -(n + \phi_\pi(s_T)) & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
method.data_source: GSM8K training set（Qwen实验）；MATH training set（Llama实验）
key_components: Constrained MDP formulation without state augmentation
Modified Saute reward with policy-dependent discrepancy term ϕ_π (KL divergence)
GRPO-based policy gradient with explicit-dependence term (II)
Binary task reward (final answer correctness)
KL budget constraint threshold d=0.35

2509.22921.novelty: 先前方法（GKD-GRPO/Agarwal 2024）用软Lagrangian松弛（固定λ权衡KL与reward），需手动调λ且无约束满足保证。本文将KL散度作为硬约束（≤d），通过改造Saute状态增广MDP（去掉z_t状态，用history重建预算）实现无teacher测试部署，同时保留almost-sure约束满足的理论保证；并引入policy-dependent惩罚ϕ_π区分infeasible轨迹的惩罚强度，提升样本效率。

on_policy_mechanism.evidence_quote: We conduct experiments on two distinct distillation settings to evaluate our proposed method. For the first setting, we distill a Qwen2.5-1.5B-Math student model from a Qwen2.5-7B-Math-Instruct teacher model using the GSM8K training dataset. For the second setting, we distilled a Llama-3.2-3B student model from a Llama-3.2-11B-Instruct teacher model using the MATH training dataset. The KL divergence between student and teacher policies is computed at each timestep as: KL(π_θ(·|s_t)||µ(·|s_t)) = Σ_{a∈V} π_θ(a|s_t) log(π_θ(a|s_t)/µ(a|s_t))

opd_classification.reasoning: student在训练循环内实时采样rollout，teacher提供per-token logits作为KL约束信号（external teacher model），同时结合binary task reward（GT answer verifier），属于on-policy + external teacher蒸馏。

training_setup.compute_budget: less than 2 days on a single accelerator per method
stabilization_tricks: KL distillation warm-up for first 3 epochs (for Llama3.2-3B due to poor initial performance)
Probability floor on logits to ensure finite KL gradient

key_findings: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Math蒸馏后在GSM8K上FAC达76.11%（teacher 92.27%），约束满足率94.99%，而GRPO（λ=0）虽FAC更高（80.06%）但约束满足率仅42.83%。
本方法在推理质量（Reasoning Win Rate）上大幅优于纯GRPO：Qwen实验RWR约58.72% vs GRPO的12.15%（GSM8K），以约束换取了更好的推理逻辑。
Llama-3.2-3B实验中约束满足率达99.60%（GSM8K），同时FAC 38.36%，优于纯KL方法（GKD: 38.36%但RWR仅41.74%），说明约束RL能在Pareto前沿上找到优越解。
2509.22921.ablations_summary: 通过Pareto前沿分析比较了不同λ的GKD-GRPO变体：本方法在约束满足率>94%的区域内同时保持最高的推理质量（RWR）；去掉ϕ_π项（仅用固定惩罚n）导致训练发散，说明policy-dependent discrepancy term是关键组件。
limitations: 约束阈值d=0.35需基于预实验选择（通过纯KL最小化实验来定），并非自动确定
实验仅在数学推理任务上验证，未涉及代码、通用指令等其他领域
理论保证依赖n→∞，实践中n=20是有限近似
failure_modes: 去掉ϕ_π项后所有infeasible轨迹受同等惩罚n，导致训练发散（constraint过严时信号消失）
Llama-3.2-3B初始性能极差（FAC≈0），纯GRPO训练不稳定，需要3 epoch KL预热才能收敛

theory.theoretical_claim: Theorem 3.1: optimal value equivalence between augmented and un-augmented MDP; Theorem 3.2: Bellman optimality + monotone value convergence as n→∞; Theorem 3.3: almost surely constraint satisfaction at optimum
theory.proof_sketch: 通过z_T可由history确定性重建（z_T = d - Σ C_π(s_t)），证明去掉状态增广不改变最优值函数；在B1-B3假设下用标准动态规划定理证明Bellman最优性；n→∞时infeasible轨迹获得-∞回报，故有限值的最优策略必满足约束a.s.。

2509.22921.relevance_to_opd: 本文是OPD的核心实例：student在线采样rollout（on-policy），用external teacher logits计算per-token KL作为约束信号，同时用GT answer verifier提供task reward。与GKD/Mini-LLM的区别在于将KL从软惩罚改为硬约束，理论上保证了teacher fidelity上界，是§5.1.2（on-policy + external teacher KD with reward）的典型代表。

2509.25100.title: ORPO-Distill: Mixed-Policy Preference Optimization for Cross-Architecture LLM Distillation
2509.25100.summary: 提出ORPO-Distill，将黑盒跨架构知识蒸馏重构为偏好优化任务：以教师多样CoT轨迹为正例、学生错误轨迹为负例，用ORPO对比损失（λ=1）训练，并通过混合策略采样（ϕ=0.5随机混合初始/最新checkpoint）生成负例，在五个QA基准上超越off/on-policy基线。

method.training_loop: 初始化：从教师采样K=8条多样正例轨迹YP（τ=0.8）。每训练iteration：采样u~U(0,1)，若u≤ϕ则从最新checkpoint qθ_{t-1}采K条负例，否则从初始模型qθ_0采K条负例；拒绝采样去除ROUGE-L>0.80重复；构建⟨x, yP, yN⟩三元组；最小化L_ORPO = L_SFT + λ*L_OR更新θ。
